review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Introduction","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"2B is both a sword and a shield.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Why choose between offensive and defensive when you can be both at the same time? In short, 2B is what Crow wishes to be, but she can't because of unknown reasons. She boasts a titanic amount of HP and can demolish enemies with ease thanks to her conversion gimmick. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Oh, and she is also the unit with the highest real-time attack in Nikke!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Performance Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"2B is an offensive defender whose ATK scales off her HP. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She has a low basic attack multiplier, and around half of her output is from Burst Skill. While her basic attack multiplier is concerningly low, her burst damage makes up for it, dealing over 3,000% at higher levels provided there is only a single enemy. This makes her quite similar to Maxwell in gameplay, whose damage heavily relies on Burst Skill. Burst damage like this usually benefits a lot from short-term but huge bonuses such as the one given by Novel's Burst Skill.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"One special thing to note about 2B is that her offensive strength scales linearly with her HP. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This means any MAX HP buffs invoked by herself or other teammates will significantly boost her ATK. However, as a defender, her base ATK stat is poor, which means all buffs that increase ATK based in the target character will be much less effective. Even then, the efficacy of ATK buffs is also inferior to HP buffs, so there is no reason to pair her with ATK-buffing units. Instead, pair her with units that boost her MAX HP instead. Detailed team compositions will be discussed later.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Furthermore, 2B is more suited to longer fights as her damage increases with time. Her S1, which is vital to her output, requires her to burst three times before reaching its max value. This makes her powerful for boss fights but weak in normal stages.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"2B relies a lot on her HP stat, which can only be gained from bond levels, equipment upgrades, limit breaks, and skill buffs. She scales extremely well with skill upgrades too, which must be prioritized.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For equipment, we recommend overloading her Body and maxing its level. This piece of gear provides a tremendous amount of HP. Her helmet and boots can also be upgraded, but these are less rewarding. To conserve materials, you can leave her Helmet and Boots at level 2 or 3 once overloaded.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"What about OL?","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" As a defender, 2B has a low base attack value, which means she benefits less from OL lines and buffs that increase ATK based on the target character (Noir is an exception). Furthermore, she alone already acquires too much attack from her S2, making attack buffs much less effective. Nevertheless, she still benefits from Elemental Damage, and critical hits can also help multiply her already insane damage. Hit Rate can allow her to hit enemy's core more conveniently, but since most of her damage is contained within her burst, it is probably not that valuable.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While rerolling, keep in mind that ATK lines are less favorable for 2B, although they do boost her output a little.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":" It is recommended to obtain Elemental DMG instead or situationally CRIT and Hit Rate.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" However, if you are tight on rocks, feel free to keep your ATK rolls (though you need to max her Head and Gloves for them to be more relevant).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"As for Skill Levels, we recommend prioritizing her S2, the core of her kit.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" You MUST level it up to 10 as soon as possible, else she will not be able to perform well. After that, you may choose to upgrade her S1 to increase her MAX HP, which in turn boosts her ATK. Or, you can upgrade her Burst to increase her overall DPS. For people with tight budgets, I recommend leaving her S1 and Burst at 5 respectively to save up Blue Manuals. That being said, upgrading her Burst is more important than her S1, as her Max HP can also be boosted with the help of other units, including but not limited to Noise, Mast, Frima, Quency, Rapunzel, and SMary.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Use 5-10-5 as a starting point","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", then develop your 2B based on the number of materials you have. Prioritize Burst upgrades but keep in mind that A2 will be coming soon too, and she wants you to save some for her.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Team Compositions","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"As mentioned earlier, 2B is about MAX HP buffs.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Fortunately, some other buffs and debuffs can also benefit her without any dilution/degradation, such as Damage Taken and CRIT. Meanwhile, ATK is significantly diluted, so it is inferior. Part Damage is a big no because her burst damage does NOT aim for parts. Keep this in mind when you are forming your team. Prioritize MAX HP, Damage Taken, and CRIT if available! We are not sure whether it is a bug or not, but Jackal's Burst Skill also buffs 2B's entire Burst damage (both instances).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Check our blog post review for 2B for a detailed team-building tips guide.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PVP Usage","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"The new hotshot in Arena, 2B has graciously landed to mercilessly slice the enemy team clean.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" While she may not be meta-defining, she is one of the best DPS out there. Remember Scarlet? She is similar, just slightly weaker as she relies on support units. Unlike Scarlet who sharpens her blade with ATK buffs, 2B needs to fortify herself to prepare for an unforgiving strike. She must be paired with units that grant her MAX HP in order for her to turn the tide, such as Noise, Mast, and Blanc. Jackal also has a special connection with her, as she gives her burst an independent damage multiplier.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Blanc is a general debuffer, she also gives MAX HP to lowest-HP unit,","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" so if your 2B's HP is low enough, Blanc will turn her into a beast!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"One advantage 2B has over Scarlet is that she is a defender","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", so she can make use of Biscuit's immunity to protect herself from an otherwise fatal hit. Use this to your advantage and craft creative teams to overwhelm your opponents!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"To use 2B in PvP, you need to invest in her Burst Skill. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Note that her burst consists of two instances: one is split among 5 units, and the last one to the highest HP enemy. She can be a great sniper!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Introduction","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-3"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A limited unit with tremendous AoE damage, A2 can constantly wreak havoc on clustered targets. Whether these are Nikkes that she fights in the Arena or raptures in the warzone, she simply pays no heed. However, her specialty is part-breaking. She also serves as a great option for campaign pushing due to her magnificent explosion range. Geared with a unique kit which raises her output in exchange for HP loss, she is the perfect depiction of “with great power comes great responsibility”. Namely, you need to keep her healthy at all times. Can you?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-3"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A2 is a Rocket Launcher wielder with a high explosion range by default, 1.5x larger than most RLs in game. She also has a slightly higher base attack multiplier and naturally provides more burst generation thanks to her S2, increased charge speed, and bonus range. However, she is actually by far one of the slowest RL units when it comes to attack speed due to forced animation. In layman's terms, in addition to the usual charging time, she takes an extra 0.8s per swing without Mode B and 0.4s per swing with Mode B active. This animation cannot be shortened with charge speed. This highly discourages uncharged attacks (or fast-tapping), but fortunately her kit revolves around fully charged attacks to deal maximum damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"That aside, she possesses a unique burst skill that activates Mode B, which continually devours her HP in exchange for a slight ATK and Charge Speed boost as long as her HP stays above 40%. This prompts her to avoid hits as much as possible (one hit, and your buff is gone) and be adequately healed to achieve maximum uptime from this buff. The recovery needed will depend on A2's MAX HP, as higher HP results in more HP loss per second overall as well as a higher threshold. In other words, although higher MAX HP means she can survive brutal hits, at the same time it will also be harder to keep her healthy. Taunters can help redirect attacks away from her, but this is unnecessary for Solo Raids (more on that below).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Mode B is permanently active if A2's HP is always above 40%, but her S1 is not. This means you still need to burst with her regardless of whether Mode B is active.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A similar drawback also applies to ATK. Naturally, she has high damage multipliers but few ATK buffs, which allows her output to scale rapidly with attack OL and buffs from support units. However, higher ATK also means she might become the primary target of Solo Raid bosses, whose attacks will in turn deactivate her Mode B and decrease her total damage. In fact, her Mode B is also equivalent to having an almost permanent ATK buff, so pay attention to that too. To compensate this, you can always pair her with taunters or, in Solo Raids, consistently-high-ATK units such as Guilty, Modernia, Scarlet, or 2B. Any other units with higher base stats and more ATK rolls than her also work.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Remember, more is good but excessive is bad! The game starts from building optimal teams that can take advantage of each character's strengths and counterbalance their weaknesses.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Performance Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-3"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A2 sees a lot of potential use in campaign and bossing, especially the ones with more than two parts. In campaign, her increased explosion range can cover nearly the entire map, allowing her to clean all raptures at once, like a sandstorm! It will also sometimes bypass certain types of shield. In bossing, she is able to conveniently hit multiple parts, even if they are distant from one another. One well-targeted rocket will damage them altogether, multiplying the damage by the number of parts affected on top of the Part Damage and Additional Damage (only once per enemy regardless of the number of parts) buffs provided by S2. That being said, her damage on bosses without parts is just grim.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Some testing shows that against bosses with 2 or more parts, a highly invested A2 has the potential to outdamage Alice and even Modernia. This might not apply to everyone, but her damage seems to be promising!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"When it comes to PvP, she might not be the best, but if you do not own other units, you are always free to use her. Without Mode B, she is capable of hitting the target plus two adjacent Nikkes at once. With Mode B, she is capable of hitting every enemy unit at the same time (starting at S1 level 7). However, her damage is on the low side, so do not hold too much expectation. Her damage is also gradual (hence, she will likely die to units that have tons of gradual healing or units with instant or nearly instant damage like Scarlet or SAnis). Moreover, since the Additional Damage instance of S2 does not trigger on covers, her burst generation is similar to that of a normal RL (like Laplace or Noise) but instead works at timings of 1.5 RL, 3 RL, and so on.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you want the equation, A2 hits 3 Nikkes * 2 ticks each plus 3 covers, resulting in 9 * 1.3% = 11.7% burst generation per hit.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill investment","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-3"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Start at 5/5/5. Upgrade skills as needed for tiny boosts of damage. The damage increase from S1, S2, and Burst are independent of each other, so they stack multiplicatively. To conserve materials, it may be wiser to upgrade Burst only when your healers cannot keep up. Save your manuals for other units such as 2B and future units (anniversary imminent).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Team Composition","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-3"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She is decent against bosses with parts, in which case she should enter one of your best teams. Against bosses with no parts, you can consider putting her in one of your worst teams instead. The support buffs that she mainly wants are ATK, Charge Speed, Charge Damage, and Part Damage. CRIT buffs are also acceptable (but NOT Mast). Max Ammo is relevant only if you do not have any Max Ammo OL.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Here are two requirements when building A2's team:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"You need at least one healer for A2, which can be in B1, B2, or B3 positions.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"in Solo Raids, A2 should be paired with a taunter if damage cannot be evaded, or she must not have the highest ATK at any time. The last two Solo Raid bosses prioritize hitting units with the highest ATK (so they are technically taunters without taunting skills). Some units have an ATK stat that fluctuates, such as Alice. This can be hard to work with. Remember, OL lines can change how a unit functions! review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ada Wong is a buffer first DPS unit capable of enhancing the damage of mainly True DMG B3 DPS. She can also complement some other B3 units well, especially in terms of healing. Ada Wong can be seen as similar to Maxwell/Crown (able to strengthen allies from the off-burst) and Emilia + MiharaBC in gameplay. In PvP, she resembles a stronger version of Alice with her continuous True DMG DoT hitting one target every second. Overall, Ada Wong packs a lot—she has multiple attributes that allow her to fit in many roles.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let's first start with her supporting role. As a support, Ada is capable of buffing ‘ATK’ and ‘True Damage’ of the B3 who uses her Burst Skill in a specific rotation. This can be useful for amplifying ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"non-instantaneous burst damage","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" from Burst Skills, such as that from SW, Alice, RH, MiharaBC, or anyone whose damage spikes dramatically during their Burst. It can also be useful for switching the target of MirandaTr's Crit Rate (which targets the highest ATK) from one unit to another in real time. Compared to Maxwell, each has their pros and cons. While Ada Wong's buff complements burst damage-type Burst Skills better, Maxwell's benefits stable DPS more since she is able to buff the other B3’s off-burst rotation as well. That said, we need to take their personal damage and the identity of the other B3 (if applicable) into account. Variations can be seen from boss to boss.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ada Wong also packs damage despite it not being mind-blowing. Her kit is not designed for Campaign, but versus Electric-weak bosses and against single targets that have high DEF, and especially in PvP, Ada Wong is a notable unit. This is because she can deal continuous True Damage via S2 both in the in-burst and off-burst positions. She also acquires a powerful one-shot attack when using Burst Skill that is useful for bursting a target down (esp. if it has core) or benefitting from short buffs like Liter's/Volume's.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you like interesting strategies, try MirandaTr. You can, like with MiharaBC, control Ada Wong to \"not shoot\" or \"hold her special attack longer\" to extend Miranda's Crit Rate as long as possible. Remember to shoot her high charge shot while Miranda’s buffs are active to enhance her damage during burst. This way, all her attacks from S2 will always crit no matter what. And you can do this with Ein and MiharaBC too, although for Ein, spamming basic attacks might be better, especially if there is a core.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Where can I expect her to be used?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Depending on the type of content, she can be a DPS or a support. For mobbing, she is strictly a support—she possesses no AoE damage and would struggle with controlling multiple spawns. For bossing, she can be a support or a DPS, depending on the team and boss configuration. Be prepared to slot her in varying comps to abuse either her buff or her damage. For the specifics, visit our Tier List section below.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"TL;DR — In Electric-weak bossing, likely a support and DPS at the same time. Despite that, Ada can still be used as a flex support if you lack better units. She can also help your Snow White get Miranda’s Crit rate buff if your Helm and Maxwell keep stealing it away from her.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In PvP, Ada Wong is like XMaiden but with two uses:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As a DPS, she has an S2 that deals continuous True Damage to one target, but this only triggers during Full Burst. Or, if you don't have MastM, Maxwell, HelmTr, and SHelm, then Siren Crown RRH RH Ada can be a good team against Ultra.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PvP: SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ada has normal RL burst gen and normal RL splash (similar to Noise/Rapunzel). Therefore, she doesn't feed and generates a good amount of burst energy. This is good given her potential as an overtime damage buffer, True DMG buffer, and XMaiden-like DPS.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let's first start with her supportive side: Ada's S1 massively buffs the B3 who is Bursting. As a buffer with better burst gen than RH and without the feeding issue of Crown, she reserves a special place in PvP. Unlike RH, though, she cannot buff instantaneous wipes like Scarlet's. This stifles her, but she still can fill in some teams.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her DPS side is what surprises us. It hits so hard (hits harder than most single-target DPS in PvP) that ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"},{"type":"bold"}],"value":"it can one-shot enemy Defenders","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", barring them from utilizing Biscuit's immune. You just have to make a team that can help her survive for 7-8 seconds. The easiest way to do it is to make a team that forces Blanc’s indomitability on her. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"After a whole year since her first introduction, Ade: the Perfect Maid is finally here! Elegance personified is the best way to describe her. You can watch her dance with light sticks in the minigame, but her dance skills do not match up to her performance. Her kit provides an interesting \"debuff shield\" from an incoming debuff, or removes an already existing debuff. She also gives small ATK buffs and a Max HP buff that does not heal. Will she be able to live up the hype, or will we have the shortest review ever? Spoiler: We will!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ade serves a very niche role, just like other cleansers currently in game - cleansing debuff, which comes with an inherent problem. Not many battles require their presence. And, let’s hope it stays this way, because from Shift Up’s previous games, they did create a lot of stages that had nasty debuffs! Ade is an alternative to XMica or Cocoa. Her debuff cleansing is team wide and does not require any skill activation the first time around. Thus, while not being able to trigger it at will is a drawback by itself, you are not forced to use her Burst Skill at all, allowing you to use stronger B2 skills.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ade's MAX HP buffs also enhance healers if their effectiveness is based on their current MAX HP! So pairing a healer with her will also be a viable option to boost the amount of healing your team receives!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ade will not be used much here. She may be helpful in stages that feature Tailbone (ATK reduction). Just like XMica, Ade will have her place if you fight against Sunbather, which inflicts -60% ATK reduction debuffs!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Union Raid","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Situational against bosses that apply major debuffs, but you'd be better off running a more versatile B2.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Solo Raid","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With the current meta teams, it’s very hard to find a spot for Ade. Everything she does, others can do and they do better. Unless Shift Up really forces a boss that constantly debuffs your team with debuffs, otherwise you may not want to put Ade in your team at all. The closest we can come up is using Ade as a replacement for Mast… if you use Mast at all.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She can, and will block Blanc’s burst, rendering her useless. Sadly, nowadays, people tend to pair Blanc with Jackal, and Jackal debuff will eat Ade’s debuff immunity first. In this case, do not run Ade! XMica should perform better than Ade for PvP by a good margin. Ade has a better burst gen than normal AR, similar to Snow White/Mihara's. However, if you look at the burst gen chart, you will realize that they are all considered “slow” there. Ade will not shake PVP meta.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should You Pull","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"NO!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" But if you really simp for Ade, the latest maid of Maid for you, then one copy does not hurt. Ade is an interesting Nikke - She works well without investment, and she does not gain much by investing in her. Maybe you can pull one copy for future proof, or put her in the wishlist instead. By future proof, we mean that she may become important when new bosses with debuffs are released. You can always rely on Cocoa and XMica for that, though.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"heading-2","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Kit Analysis","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Ade's kit revolves around the ability to protect your teammates from filthy debuffs, by both cleansing and preventing them at the same time. In addition, she provides a little ATK buff longside a decent “empty” HP bar buff that can be filled in order to provide extra defensive capability.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 1","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"This skill has 2 parts:","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"All teammates will gain a stack of Debuff Immunity which removes an existing debuff (but will not remove CP penalty and special debuffs like Suppression/Stun Rope of “Sentry”…) and prevents the next incoming debuff if it is not consumed yet. In Nikke, debuffs are currently not an issue to require specific methods dealing with. Some debuffs can be nasty, like Blanc’s burst in pvp, ATK reduction from some Raptures/Bosses like TailBone and that’s where Ade might shine. One advantage of prepared debuff removal is that you don't have to delay or wait for the next burst rotation.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"embedded-asset-block","data":{"target":{"sys":{"id":"66Nly8eYTddtYBj4QdsEjV","type":"Link","linkType":"Asset"}}},"content":[]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"This is how you'll be looking at Tail Bone when Ade renders it useless!","marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The other part is an ATK buff. Though you can maintain this buff like 100% of the time by keeping her HP hovering up/down 90%, the effect is definitely not worth the pain. Assuming Ade has the same core / gears / level / bond affections with your Attacker, her ATK stat will be 83.33% of your DPS, which translates this S1’s effect into 4.3% ATK up for an Attacker. The value is underwhelming, but it can be combined with her other skills to make a decent value.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The Debuff Immunity does not work like a “Vaccine”. It will not make you “immune” to a certain debuff for the whole stage, but rather it acts as a “Shield” that blocks the next upcoming debuff or removes an already existing debuff. Note that debuff blocking may harm you instead, for example Sanis without Ammo Reduction, or A2 without HP reduction (her burst effect will not trigger at all if this debuff is removed!).","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Since Nikke treats timing of skills in this order: Self skill > External skill, hence Debuff Immunity will mostly consume your own debuff first before it can block any harmful external Debuff. Essentially, whichever debuff was applied first will be removed by Ade.Once Ade has < 90% HP, she needs to be > 90% HP to retrigger the ATK buff (in her skill 1) with the help of her S2 or Burst Skill (both of which reduce her HP below 90%, and bring it back up after the buff expires). If she has already been under 90% max HP and is not healed back to > 90%, she will ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"NEVER","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" trigger S1 attack buff.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"DO NOT RUN ADE WITH S.ANIS OR A2. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ade is a capable support unit slightly below Grave and above Mari in performance. When using her Burst, she grants a vast amount of offensive buff to her teammates: 55% ATK DMG, which is universal, and 10% Pierce DMG. She can also add 18.36% Pierce DMG on top by hitting enemies within effective range (damage distance bonus), improving the damage of Pierce allies and herself. Doing that will also grant everyone a minute but substantial caster's ATK buff, which unlike Mari's temporary S2, can be permanent as long as a valid target exists. Taking everything into account, Ade is a Pierce-specific damage buffer with different activation requirements from Mari's but better performance when circumstances allow. She is also more of a single-target support since she does not provide AoE support like Mari.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Where can I expect her to be used?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ade can be used in all kinds of content, whether with Pierce DPS or Regular DPS. Her Pierce portion is not as much as Mari's, and thus Ade is more universal. As a universal B2 with Pierce focus, she can fit in many teams, including Electric Cindy comps and hyper-Pierce teams involving Red Hood, Alice, SW, Doropity, or the new unit Milk. In this position, she rivals Grave, who provides less buff but accelerates rotation—which curiously surpasses the tradeoff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With this information, Ade is likely going to be a staple unit in Raids, especially Solo Raid where there are 5 teams. She is not going to be the first choice in UR because the first 3 Top B2 spots are competitive, but she can still be a good alternative, especially over Mari in the famous Cindy-Anis-Maiden Electric comp. In SR, she is not restricted to a specific element, although obviously she will deal more in Iron-weak. She is also not restricted to enemies within effective range, although if there is no valid target, her buff diminishes a little. In any element, she can join Pierce teams as the BiS support (i.e. if you use Grave with SW, then you can use Ade with Milk/RH; maybe you can pair her with Doropity too) or as a regular support (bruteforce Cindy teams; Ade being Iron helps with breaking Iron QTE). She seems to have a promising future, and you should get plenty of value out of her.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In Campaign or mobbing situations, her performance remains similar, although her usage may falter. She does not provide AoE support, so she doesn't scale like Mari does, but her buffs remain intact. In fact, it is easier to find a valid target for activating S1/S2 when there are a lot of enemies. This makes her a valid buffer B2 choice, much better than SRosanna, since Damage Taken only applies to current but not new enemies; and Mari in terms of buff consistency (Mari's ATK buff goes on & off). As an Iron with Pierce, she can also help break Shields and kill Iron-vulnerable enemies.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This leads to her being usable in Tetra Tower, which until now, has been limited to Blanc & Crust (if you cope with Bready). With Ade as a strong addition, you no longer have to rely on Blanc. In fact, the best Tetra Tower carry is Alice, who has Pierce! How (un)surprising! It's finally time to dismiss them... or not. They might be better, but you can run something like Alice Rouge SAnis BAde XLud.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In PvP, Ade is much more limited versus Mari. This is because Ade doesn't have AoE support. She is just a \"nothing special\" B2 buffer. That said, her ATK DMG on Burst is higher than Mari's. Even then, we are not expecting much out of her in PvP. If any, she's just a \"gigantic buffer\". Do note we are still researching PvP's damage distance, which was insinuated to exist by the latest patch note.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull her?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Good question. Our answer is YES. A staple B2 that improves compositional flexibility in Raids is always a \"should pull\". Not having her will make you take an impactful hit in Solo Raid performance. If that's important to you, don't skip her. Otherwise, feel free to skip; she won't see much use outside because she's not replacing Crown, who is the best B2 we have right now. Similarly, if you only care about PvP, then no, Ade is not helping you there.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should you mileage her? No, especially if you already have Mari built. Ade is an excellent option for Mari-less players and for competitive Raiders who want to improve their damage, but you can cope with whatever you have and find alternatives to using Ade, even when she is BiS. Not only that, Ade will enter Ordinary after her banner ends, which reinforces our suggestion that you should skip in favor of possible collab dropping in October and Pilgrims in November. Those units will either be limited or hard to get outside their banners. And there is also SAnis rerunning right now, who is limited; perhaps getting her first is a better idea. To top it all off, why would you use Mileage on a 2% unit? Save them for 1% Pilgrims! In conclusion, while Ade is an essential Raid unit, she's not worth Golden Mileage; that said, make sure to put her in Wishlist.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I get dupes for her? No. Save spending gems for dupes of DPS or units with higher usage & versatility and ATK/caster's ATK buff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 1 & 2","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Whenever Ade lands a Full Charge attack on targets within effective range (blue crosshair; ×0.3 damage multiplier, additive to core and crit hits), she buffs all allies with ATK▲ 15.2% of Ade's base ATK and Pierce DMG▲ 18.36% for 5 seconds.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"On automatic, Ade Full Charge(s) all attacks, so this buff is permanent.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, you may want to manual and spam quick shots with her for burst gen.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since this scales off Ade's base ATK, equipment levels, dupes, dolls, and cubes influence it. ATK OL does not influence it.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Also active when she is not Bursting—making her an okay off-burst buffer but not necessarily good.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Hypothesis: If Spy Lens are fully stacked, and Burst is active, all enemies become \"within effective range\".","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Additionally, whenever she lands any Full Charge attack, regardless of whether it hits an enemy within effective range, she gains 1 stack of Spy Lens. Spy Lens decreases her minimum effective range by 4.4% per stack for up to 10 stacks, for 5 sec. This expands her range from 45~100 to 25.2~100 (note their multiplicative relationship). This makes her weapon have a similar starting distance as AR (25).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Beware of its short duration; if you spam for burst gen for too long, control her without shooting, or she is in cover for too long, the stacks will reset to 0.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This does not matter much as having max stacks is only necessary for giving Pierce and ATK▲ to self, whose damage is negligible. Speaking of which, when Ade is at max stacks (10) of Spy Lens, she gains Pierce & 16% ATK.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, if you need the Minimum Effective Range▲ to activate her S1 & S2's supportive buffs, then losing stacks will make you lose them too.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"At 25.2, she should be able to hit most if not all bosses with damage distance.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Burst Skill","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For the next 10s, Ade buffs herself with Minimum Effective Range▲, similar to the one from Spy Lens. Together, they total 100%, lowering the minimum distance for damage bonus from 45 to 0, which includes all enemies.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can be a good emergency tool for maintaining support buffs when Spy Lens' stacks are interrupted for any reason.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This makes her effective at all ranges, including SMG's/SG's.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With increased damage bonus on closer enemies, she can activate S1 & S2's supportive buffs more reliably and take down close-by targets.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ade also gives a whopping 55.04% ATK DMG and 10.13% Pierce DMG to all teammates for 10 sec, similar to Mari and Grave in fashion.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"These buffs, combined with S1 & S2, make Ade grant a total of 55.04% ATK DMG & 28.49% Pierce DMG, strikingly similar to the percentage of Mari's and Grave's ~80% buffs, just with a different composition.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This technically makes her more universal than both—but Mari grants AoE support and Grave grants burst gen support, which is often more impactful. Notice how their elements are different as well, Water and Wind next?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since ATK DMG constitutes a large portion of her buffs, she is quite universal, although she works best with Pierce DPS.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She can pair with regular DPS as a regular buffer or as a buffer that can break Iron QTE. For example, you can run Cindy Rouge SAnis Ade XMaiden. Whether that's optimal for your own account is a different question. In Iron-weak, there are a lot of Iron DPS with Pierce that you want to pair Ade with instead, unless you don't have them built.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Iron Piercers: SW, Red Hood, BMilk, Maxwell","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Non-Iron Piercers: Alice, Doropity, Asuka","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"ATK DMG is often diluted versus Damage Taken, but ATK DMG is a buff, not a debuff, so you deal the same damage to old and new enemies that spawn after buff is given, unlike with Damage Taken. This makes her a possibly more attractive choice than SRosanna in Campaign if not paired with Sustained DPS or Tetra Tower replacing Blanc.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Tier List & Usage Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD): SS | Campaign (HD): S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"BAde is an impressive B2 Campaigner, possessing a kit that buffs ATK, ATK DMG, and Pierce DMG substantially. She does not provide AoE support like Mari or burst gen support like Grave, but her intrinsic buff values are stronger. The problem with Mari in Campaign is her inconsistent ATK buff, whereas the problem with Grave is her burst gen support is kind of pointless without Liter/Volume (whose CDR ramps up and is not instant, which is unideal for Campaign) and she doesn't provide ATK buff at all. Introducing BAde, the best alternative B2 after Crown who is not bound to anyone. No duos. Just simple plug-and-play.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"BAde can be used to a great extent. No, she's not better than Crown, but if you don't have Crown or Maids (MastM is pretty good), then BAde is obviously the next best choice. She's just good, very good. Not impressive as Crown but remarkable.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Oh, and she's one of the best buffers for Tetra Tower now, if not the best.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing: SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The modern B2 buffer, someone who also doesn't have as tight a requirement as Mari's and provides more buffs than Grave (in exchange for the lack of burst gen support). In comparison to Grave, we found a lot of varying results where Grave was usually better for pierce units and Ade was better for non-pierce units, but it still wasn’t always true. Results may vary depending on your account and investment into the DPS being used in the team, as well as the investment in OL for Grave and even Ade’s OL. Regardless, Ade is the new staple B2 for all intents and purposes. In SR, you will see her being plugged anywhere—Cindy comps, SG comps with Doropity, Hyperpierce comps with SW, Alice, RH, BMilk, Asuka, or Maxwell. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A tribute to all Alice stans, the world's probably most idolized princess, Alice decided to shake up the meta once again not as a DPS this time but as a support long sought by well-known pathfinders that have endured the winding and unpredictable rocky terrains. While she does significantly improve the reliability of SG teams, something feels unfulfilling. The exodus is close to completion but is not there yet; that's our foresight.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Does this mean is mediocre? However, she does little to stabilize Tove's S1, aka the stacks. If you are unlucky, you may need to wait a thousand centuries between Full Bursts or, worse, spend all your savings just to get her. But, overall? The improvement is already paramount even with this setback, so it doesn't in any way make her unusable.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Although her performance as an SG optimizer is slightly off perfection, she as a healer is still superior to many other options. She would easily fit in many teams, especially Crown's, as she needs ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"frequent","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" external healing to regularly activate her S2 offensive buff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Just for her versatility alone, disregarding her potential in the SG team, she is worth pulling. This helps her settle in quite easily when it comes to Campaign-type missions, especially in Low Deficit campaign where healing can help survive a ton of attacks. It only strengthens B. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since we have poured our heart into Mast's essay, we will keep Anchor's review short. In a nutshell, Anchor is MastM's destined pair, enabling her entire kit and neutralizing her downsides. Together, they are powerful for coreless environments, and the QoL boost they provide is unparalleled due to the healing they provide.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Similar to MastM, Anchor can also be used alone in the off-burst or even main burst B2 positions (although highly situationally) to provide the team with Distributed Damage buff, ATK buff, Reload Speed, and occasional healing (if you use Burst Skill or have another Aegis member in team). This can also activate Crown's S2 albeit less frequently compared to HelmTr or Naga. Anchor's main selling points, however, are her survivability-focused Burst Skill that grants the team Overheal. This allows the team to store excess HP recovery and use them to tank otherwise lethal attacks in PvE and PvP content. Along with this, her ability to cleanse off Mast’s Debuff is what makes her the perfect unit to pair alongside Mast.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Absolutely","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", especially if you have pulled or are planning to pull MastM. However, if you are a casual player or lean towards the casual side, ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"you may skip this banner to save up for EVA 2.0","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" if you lack funds for it since both Maids: Mast and Anchor, will enter the wishlist.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Is Anchor better than Mast when used as an independent off-burst B2? Not really. Although Anchor's buffs are not far behind and more stable, you are limited to utilizing her S1 and S2 buffs because her Burst Skill is weak on the offense (unless the extra survivability matters). The key difference is that a substantial portion of Anchor's ATK is consumed outside Full Burst. However, in exchange, her Reload Speed buff always stays at 40.4%▲, lasts for 15s, and does not fluctuate.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Additionally, Anchor is also an incredibly usable unit for PvP. The current meta in PvP revolves around bruising and wiping and anti-wiping, which sucks because there is barely any counter. Fortunately, Anchor's arrival saves the day, somewhat. Anchor's Burst Skill allows the team to tank a larger amount of instant damage and additionally provides the team with recovery on top of HP potency if paired with another Aegis member like HelmTr. This makes her a great alternative for Scarlet-XAnne comps and a core unit for stalling comps especially with HelmTr.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In conclusion, if you are a core Solo Raid or Union Raid player or care about your PvE well-being, pull her (and MastM). If you are an avid PvP player, pull her too. There is nothing better than having a unit for security. Besides, who knows the EVA 2 units will harmonize with them better?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Is she worth the mileage?","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" If you already have Mast and somehow ran out of gems when attempting to pull for Anchor, then perhaps it's justifiable. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Otherwise, if you do not have enough resources, it's definitely better to skip both Mast and Anchor and wishlist them instead.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor is the weaker of the bunch, since Mast can be paired with Crown for some off-burst power. However, Mast is supposed to be paired with Anchor, who can negate her downsides. Compared to Crown, the team is weaker in Survivability in Campaign due to having no shield (mobs there one-shot at higher deficits). You are also limited to 2 B3 and cannot use RH-B1 + B1/B2 CDR strat. It is a good alternative especially when it comes to buffing DPS that have weak core damage, such as SBS, or units with reload speed scaling like Rapipi and Alice. The problem? Well, they need to stack before their buffs even become impactful. And you also need high skill investments.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Just like Bunnies, using them in Campaign means you won’t be able to pull some extremely hairloss move where you beat the stage around 40% deficit. But let those bald guys mald! We casual gang just want something easy to operate, hence we run Bunnies 2.0 Aka El Macho. They have ATK buffs and healing, which are something we want in Campaign situationally. They are good for bossing, but Crown + HelmTr might still be better.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If a player does not have Crown, Maid Anchor and Maid Mast are probably the next best thing after the Tia-Naga duo. Blanc-Noir compete closely, but the fact that the Maid Duo provides buffs to allies and not debuffs to opponents makes them more usable in the overall meta! With Tia's taunt being hard to use for most players, Maid Duo can provide a very usable alternative in Campaign to players without Crown.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor is Mast's comrade in arms. You can hardly separate them in content that rely on min-maxing. As the new powercreep to Blanc-Noir and situationally better than the Tia Naga duo, the Maids will have their place in Team 2-4 in Solo Raid (and likely be one of the mainstays in Union Raid too). Solo Raid bosses usually don't have a core, which gives them an edge. Not only that, we have 2 DPS that scale extremely well on Reload Speed: Alice and Rapipi. Both of them are more likely to be paired with the Maids, although element-related restrictions may interfere.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We expect that the Maids will be paired with SBS and Alice for most raids, except on Electric-weak Raids, where adjustments need to be made due to lack of decent Electric B1 CDR outside Rouge. In water weak raids, we may even see Quency: Escape Queen being paired with the Maids.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In content that relies solely on maxxing (outside Raids), her impact on the meta will depend on Crown's effectiveness. If Crown is the \"absolute best\" and is indispensable, then Anchor will probably see less usage than Mast as the other might be the better off-burst support. However, that doesn't prohibit you from using her in that fashion. Who knows she might be better? More stable reload speed, longer but weaker ATK buffs, etc. Additionally, if she is paired with another Aegis member—which doesn't have to be Mast—she can also trigger Crown's S2.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"There is also a very decent QoL on Kraken, which we will detail in the team building section.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Lastly, we also want to reiterate that the Maids are one of the best supports for coreless content, below Crown + HelmTr. Despite numbers showcasing them potentially being weaker than Naga variants in cored contents, they are still a valuable asset to invest in (unless SU powercreeps them like Rem [poor her]).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor in PvP is a survivability-focused B2 unit that has some offensive power, comparable to XAnne. Both provide the team damage and boost their survivability in different ways. One gives revive + healing to Attackers, and the other relies on teamwide healing and padding. While XAnne might be better in most comps due to her tremendous impact with revive and obviously stronger ATK buff, Anchor is a great alternative for PvE players who don't want to invest in PvP. Since you will be building her for PvE, you can also just slap her there and call it a day.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A main use for Anchor might be alongside other healers. This way, Anchor can be a crucial unit for blocking AoE attacks. Her HP padding + potential synergy with HelmTr or other B1 Healers allows for some unique stalling properties. However, as a B2, she cannot be triggered alongside other B2 units, so no Nero + Anchor combo (except in 2 FB comps). :/","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We also have an announcement to make here! We hope to deliver updated PvP information by next month with the advent of Champions Arena to you all! The tier list rework for 5 teams is already in works!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor is a survivability-focused 40s B2 that naturally grants the team ATK, Distributed Damage, and Reload Speed, along with recovery if certain conditions are met or her Burst Skill is used. Anchor wields a non-clip RL, which makes her better than other weapons when it comes to generating burst gen.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 1","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor grants the team a mixture of buffs depending on how many times the team has entered Full Burst. Previous effects will retrigger.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The first trigger grants HP potency, which is often useless for PvE but good for PvP. However, it pairs well with the second component of this skill. It does ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"not","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" affect her Burst Skill healing, though.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The second trigger grants Distributed Damage▲, an offensive buff that boosts distributed damage. Currently, it is a bit niche because the only good in-burst distributed damage dealer is SBS. QEQ does not count because her Distributed Damage is not affected by S1.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"And the last one grants a debuff stack count reduction that prevents Mast from stunning herself. This action, however, does ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"not","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" dispel non-stackable debuffs.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Additionally, if there is another Aegis member in the team, which can be the new Mast or old Mast, her R self, or either Helm variant, she will continuously regenerate the team's HP over 8 seconds. As long as the condition is met, you can treat this as an off-burst healing, and the effect is comparable to Blanc's Full Burst healing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor's Burst Skill grants the team a maximum of 60.19% of caster's Max HP (base, not final) as overheal. However, her Burst Skill only heals up to 40.18% of it. With another Aegis member in the team, you can ensure that the overheal will always be filled to the brim.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 2","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Depending on how many times the team has exited Full Burst, Anchor grants the team a mixture of tactical buffs. Previous effects retrigger.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The first trigger grants the team increased Hit Rate▲, which helps offset Mast's self-debuff and boosts the team's core hit rate, but it is nowhere impactful. This allows Mast to achieve perfect accuracy with only 3× Hit Rate OL lines, hence our passable recommendation.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The second trigger enhances the team ATK for 10s. Pretty self-explanatory, but we do want to mention, depending on how fast you cycle Burst, its overlap duration with Full Burst will lengthen or shorten.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The last one is the most valuable aspect of this skill: Reload Speed. Lasting for 15s, it grants the team a lot of uptime increase and QoL boost for charging burst gen. When paired with MastM's Reload Speed, you can achieve perfect reload or “infinite ammo”, a phenomenon where SRs/RLs will not drop a single ammo when shooting. This ensures that at the end of Full Burst, they will have full magazines, allowing for seamless burst gen without reloading.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor's 10s ATK buff and 15s Reload Speed buff are her greatest assets. You want to make the most of them by making them overlap with FB time as much as possible, which requires cycling Burst fast. Learn how to prepare Full Charge toward the end of Full Burst with SR/RL weapons and release them as soon as the Full Burst ends, then follow up with spamming. You might need to swap between units.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Burst Skill","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor grants Storage to all allies, heal them a large amount, and boost their ATK for 10s.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"},{"type":"underline"}],"value":"### What is Storage?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Storage, a buff introduced first by Marciana, is the capability of storing excess recovery. The overheal is stored as extra HP on top of the current HP, but it is not treated as Max HP▲ (so no buffs to Max HP-scaling skills), nor does it deactivate \"Triggers at max HP\" skills if not fully filled. In other words, they are just a weaker Max HP▲ that offer the same survivability bonuses.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor's Storage lasts for 25 seconds, which means it can potentially last permanently if the team rotates very fast, but in most cases it will just drop right before her Burst, but that's fine as it doesn't impact the effect. The long duration is beneficial for allowing the team to tank damage that would have otherwise killed them.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Storage synergizes well with her S1 and also outside recovery from Noise, Helm, etc. This is because they can also fill the Storage, not just Anchor. However, this is not needed for most content.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"After applying Storage, Anchor subsequently heals the team based on her final Max HP. Since this chronologically happens after Storage, it can fill the Storage, which means her heal will not be wasted. The Storage + Heal combo is powerful in PvP where the padded HP is important for tanking critical AoE attacks.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Lastly, Anchor also grants the team ATK buff. It's small but nothing to scoff at. It adds an offensive spark to her defensive kit. Good for PvP, although don't expect her to make your wiper a terminator. Remember that it scales off base ATK, so make sure to OL her helmet, vest, and gloves for stat.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Gear Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Just like Mast, as a supporter, Anchor doesn’t need specific OL lines. You still want to OL her gear for higher base stats (because her kit scales on caster’s ATK). Prioritize Helmet, Vest/Body, and Gloves. Boots are optional because they don’t give ATK stat, but the extra CP padding may be useful for Campaign or Tower.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"1-2× Max Ammo is a good QoL for Burst Generation in cases where Alice is not used alongside the Maid Duo. We advise you keep whatever you get initially (T11s are good for CP padding) and don’t attempt to reroll.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Essential:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Ideal:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" 4× ELE, 4× ATK, 1-2× Max Ammo","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Passable:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Priority:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Low","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anchor, like Mast, is an investment heavy unit. Her budget skill recommendations mostly rely on what Mast’s skills are.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill 1: 4/7/10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can leave at 4 or 7 for budget. This skill mostly has to do with healing, and the cleanse works at lvl1 as well. Ultimately, due to the Distributed Damage buff in this skill, you want to max out this skill once your budget allows you to.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill 2: 7/8/9/10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Prioritize this skill because it not only gives ATK Buff, but also gives Reload Speed. For other weapons, you can settle at Lv 7. However, for units like Alice, you want this skill to be minimum Lv 7 (with Lv 10 Mast’s S2), or Lvl 8~9 (with Lvl 9 Mast’s S2) to obtain “infinite ammo” through having >109% reload speed. Alice will literally never drop a single bullet in 4th+ Full Burst (disclaimer: only with Resilience 7+). Eventually, due to the ATK buff in this skill, you have to get it up to 10 as well, unfortunately. Damage is damage after all, and the scaling is the normal ×1.69 (from lvl 1->lvl 10)for the ATK buff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Burst Skill:4/7/10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A lot of Healing and ATK buffs to go alongside it. This skill is similar to Skill 1 in priority since it is mostly healing focused with an ATK buff attached to it. As usual, offensive buffs mean that in the end you want to max out this skill as well.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cube Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For true “infinite ammo”, you will need Resilience 7+ and Mast:RM or Crown.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PvP cubes to improve Anchor’s survivability.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Doll Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Same as Mast, she is not worth too much doll investment because her own DPS is meh. However, she scales off base ATK stat, and for all we know, dolls’ stats are undiscriminating. It gives the same base ATK stat boost to a Defender as it does to an Attacker. Hence, putting a leveled Doll on Anchor can prove worthy due to the ubiquitous caster’s ATK buffs.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Depending on your competitiveness in Solo Raid, either SR 0 or SR 5 should be your end goal. SR 15 feels excessive even though you can justify it.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"What does a SR do in PVP? Well Anis has 0 impact kits. In fact, we don’t even remember her skills at all! The only good thing about Anis is, she has quite a good burst gen. How good you may ask? Highest in PVP, only below Helm Treasure version and Trina by 0.4%, on par with Jackal. This makes her one of the best batteries in PVP, and to be honest, that’s all we need. Sadly, using her in Rookie and Special Arena will probably put your team in disadvantage, since SR Nikke has lower combat power than SSR version, and in those 2 modes, lower CP = stat penalty (surpass 15.41% deficit). But in new mode Champion Arena, that system doesn’t exist, making Anis a must in any high ranking CA teams.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The long-awaited unit with insane DPS and unquestionable supportive skills. A hybrid between DPS and support who fulfill both roles equally well. Too well, in fact. With Privaty, her damage can surpass Modernia and Scarlet in specific situations, such as when the enemy does not have a core or is of Water-type. This means she is also one of the best DPS one can abuse right now. Not only that, but she also buffs all Electric Nikkes in the team, particularly Scarlet, who enjoys around 30-50% DPS boost depending on Scarlet's base max ammo. Combine that with Priv for 109%+ reload speed, and Scarlet will reach greater heights!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For bossing, her potential is endless and proven. She is just a relentless beast waiting for the perfect moment to consume her enemy with massive electricity. She fights best against Water, but in reality, she is a maelstrom against other elements too. Against some bosses, she might even out-damage Scarlet and Modernia.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Meanwhile, for the campaign, she is a great buffer and might be situationally useful in certain stages with Water enemies.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Finally, for PvP, she is the embodiment of obliteration itself, punishing enemies who underestimate her Skill 2. Since her Skill 2 targets two enemies at once, taunters can only redirect one of them. This allows Anis to kill enemy DPS quickly! ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anis: Sparkling Summer also scales well with OL lines. You would want to aim for Attack and Elemental OL when possible. Hitrate is not bad either, but treat it as a bonus. DISPOSE OF ALL MAX AMMO LINES and AVOID USING HER WITH UNITS THAT INCREASE MAX AMMO.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Speaking of skill investments, upgrading her Skill 1 should be prioritized, followed by Skill 2. Her burst does not require upgrading much since most of the time using Privaty is enough. Better to conserve those Burst Manuals! If you plan to use Anis: Sparkling Summer in PvP, there is actually an incentive at Burst Level 9, which lowers her max ammo to 1 and exponentially increases her damage. \n","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}
