review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you ask us for a reason to pull Arcana, we would probably give a very biased answer. Simply put by Gatrix: “I’m a fan”. If you finish her event story, who can even not love our little blue Nemo? For the Commander to shine bright, someone ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"must","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" cry in the dark. Not to mention she actually revives(?) one of the day-1 Pilgrims—Isabel—back into meta.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Arcana is a solid buffer with an asterisk—she only works with one unit, Isabel. No, she does not work with other Electric B3 such as Maiden or other Full Burst shorteners such as Vesti. Her kit was, in fact, worded in such a way that might deceive people into thinking that she would work with them. In reality, Arcana's skills require the presence of her exclusive buff, Wheel of Destiny, to activate. It must be active when the event \"Full Burst ends\" is triggered. Unfortunately, unless you pair her with a Full Burst shortener, it would always expire before the end of a Full Burst. Why doesn't Vesti work then? Well, that's because the skills only apply to Electric B3….","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, if we are only concerned about her performance with Isabel, she is actually a solid buffer. It elevates her from 'trash' to Scarlet-Trina level, which is definitely amazing and something everyone can work with. This allows her to participate in Electric-weak Solo Raids as a meta unit, and potentially Union Raids as well. She also has a hidden ability of \"buffing the other B3\" through allowing them to Burst more (9× instead of 6~7× due to rotations being shorter). Even then, when it comes to the team’s overall damage, Arcana (with Isabel) still does not surpass the level of Cindy-SAnis-XMaiden trio under Elemental conditions, so do not expect them to become relevant in one-team damage maxing content such as Anomaly Interception (and Shooting Range, technically), unless you do not have one of xMaiden or S.Anis. It is another story at that point, since ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Isabel x Cindy","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" duo would be the best performing team for Electric-bossing content.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since Isabel is a terrible mobber (due to her having to stack up for Burst Skill AoE damage), that would also make Arcana not viable for mobbing, although you can use them if you don't have another choice. Arcana's S2 CDR should allow Isabel to inflict some AoE damage. Arcana doesn't really buff Isabel's Burst Skill wipe, though, because most of her buffs only activate at the end of Full Burst. Arcana is also not a good PvP unit, either, for the same reasons. She has limited usage as a filler 40s B2 buffer/debuffer with decent burst generation thanks to her being RL. Her CDR may actually allow for some interesting strategies, but they're rather unreasonable.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In PvP, Arcana is just a filler 40s B2 buffer/debuffer with decent burst generation thanks to her being an RL wielder. She is not better than other B2 buffers such as Anchor: Innocent Maid or Trina. Most of her buffs only activate at the end of Full Burst and are only for Electric allies. Plus, her mini AoE is too small to matter as well. Fortunately, she does not need to be paired with Isabel in PvP, unless that is your objective (aka you want to end Full Burst fast, buff Isabel, then get to the next rotation faster, which can be a viable strategy in the future maybe, not now though). Note that you can use Vesti too in this case, but you will be missing the majority of Arcana's buffs. The Tier List Analysis discusses this in more detail.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I get this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Arcana is a niche unit designed for spenders or people who love Isabel/have her built and care about Electric Raids a lot. She is pretty much her Treasure. If you want to use her, you'll have to build her AND Isabel as well, which can be expensive combined. Since these costs can pile up and entail long-term effects, we recommend skipping for most players.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you already have Isabel built or are willing to invest in both Arcana and Isabel for the next Electric-weak Raid, then consider pulling. They can help nudge you higher in the leaderboard in Solo Raids, assuming we get an Electric-weak solo raid anytime soon. Do manage your resources wisely should this be the case. We would still say that, unless you’re looking to focus only on Electric solo raids, do not pre-invest in this niche duo.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Finally, Arcana does benefit from dupes. This is because the ATK buff she gives to Isabel scales off the caster's base ATK stat, which dupes affect. And 180% (+~55%) is NOT a small amount. In fact, her dupes can be more important than Isabel's.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"On the other hand, if you do not care about electric-weak Solo Raids, or do not plan to build Isabel, just skip this unit and fish from wishlist and Tower molds. But, that is for collection purposes only.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"We do not recommend spending Golden Mileage on this unit at all.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"C","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While Isabel is not that viable for mobbing, and Arcana doesn't make that much better (she does speed up Isabel's S2, which allows her to have better mobbing performance), Arcana can still be used without Isabel. You are missing out on a lot of her buffs. However, if you can utilize the Damage Taken and ATK DMG provided by her Burst Skill and are not troubled by its long CD, make use of the small caster's ATK and ATK DMG that trigger every Full Burst even when Arcana is in the off-burst, and benefit from her mini wipe that will most of the time do nothing, then there is no problem. Even then, no, she is still not better than most meta B2. In fact, it's very, very cope.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"One good thing, however, is the fact that Arcana gives a lot of ATK (to Isabel), so at least Isabel can deal damage to enemies even at extremely high deficits. For your information, CP deficit increases stat penalty, which reduces your ATK. Once your ATK falls below enemy DEF, your units will only be dealing 1 damage each time.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A main idea, possibly, is to utilize Isabel’s short burst duration and allow the other B3 to burst more often, essentially funneling the damage into that Burst 3 unit! This can be effective in Low Deficit Campaign, but is probably not so effective in High Deficit Campaign or Tribe Tower. Perhaps, it is usable against High Deficit Campaign/Tower bosses that are weak to Electric, such as Crystal Chamber. This duo can come into play thanks to Arcana’s insane 180% ATK buff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Trina-level because Arcana enables Isabel like Trina enables Scarlet and both are as niche as each other (though one may see more usage). Isabel is now a top 3 Electric DPS (by pure numbers), but that is only if you can work with Arcana's long 40s cooldown, which is interestingly not an issue for many, yet people inflate this issue too much. Look at Mast Maid + Anchor Maid. Now, they are a staple, aren't they?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The only thing that you should keep in mind is that Arcana forces the team to be a 1-2-2 and have a CDR. The CDR can be in any Burst Stage. Additionally, Arcana + Isabel don't have that great of a burst gen, so you also want another battery. Rouge or Trina or DrakeTr or Siren with 1-2 MGs is probably enough. Depending on the team, one will be more suitable, of course. Last but not least, Arcana + Isabel team is heavily dependent on manual play as quicker rotations and faster burst charging are central to utilizing Arcana's short lingering ~5s buffs.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let's get to Arcana's performance with Isabel. As we explained before, they shine in Electric-weak Raids and especially if the boss is in a reachable range (not as far and thin as Stormbringer). They may lack presence outside Electric-weak because there may be better choices in other elements, or in contents when only 1 team is needed—like in Anomaly Interception—where Summer Anis + Maiden: Ice Rose combo, who provide elemental damage and constant teamwide ATK buffs, can beat out Arcana + Isabel teams when it comes to overall team damage. They may still put up a good fight if both are well invested, especially if bosses are in Isabel's effective range and Elemental is not active. If the boss has no core, it is possible that Arcana + Isabel with Cinderella can beat out the Cinderalla + S.Anis + xMaiden wombo combo.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"To summarize, we will see more Arcana + Isabel in action when the next Electric-weak Raid comes, either in Solo Raid (or Union Raid). You can still use them outside Raid if you want, but whether that's efficient or effective depends on whether you lack those limited seasonal units, whom most players already have built.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"C","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Most of her buffs will not be active until the end of Full Burst or without the presence of Isabel or another Full Burst shortener. This makes her useless and no more than Mari/Grave, for example, at least in the buffing department. However, she wields an RL, which means she provides decent burst generation without feeding. If Burst Skill is used, she also inflicts a meager Damage Taken increase and gives a small amount of ATK DMG to Electric allies, which is better than nothing—coincidentally, most relevant DPS PvP units are Electric. She also has a mini AoE, which may help clean up 1-HP enemies. Don't rely on it, though; it's smarter to pretend it doesn't exist.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With Isabel (or alternatively Vesti [but she won't get the buffs]), Arcana can allow a more PvE-like development where the first Full Burst is shortened to accelerate the commencement of the second rotation, which can prove useful to counter certain defense units like Noah. However, this team lacks survivability (because Arcana's and Isabel's Burst Skills must be used) and is rather unreasonable.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"ShiftUp is not letting us rest again this time, are they? This time, we get a solid addition to our core SG team. How does Arcana work, and how much impact does owning her give? How meta is she? Let's study together just like in the minigame!","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Altcana, or ArcanaFM, is a mainstay SG buffer with dependable ATK and ATK DMG buffs. ATK DMG is a rarity in most SG comps, given Tove's big ATK buffs, making it precious. They have a simple activation requirement, but it is gated by Tove, so she is less effective without Tove in team. That said, unless there's a niche B2 such as OG Arcana or Nayuta taking over, ArcanaFM is the best general and ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"non-specialized","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" B2 for SG Team.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"We can see that ArcanaFM will easily be relevant for Fire-weak and Water-weak SR, with potential use in Wind-weak SR if we get a good standalone Wind SG B3 (or if SG team doesn’t get power-creeped). Her presence in Iron-weak SR can be overshadowed by Nayuta because Nayuta's buffs last longer, but she is still a very competent buffer. If healing and constant screen wipes are not needed, and ArcanaFM is invested, she can beat Nayuta. In Electric-weak, she is trounced by OG Arcana if you have Isabel. Note that ArcanaFM is strong, and you can still use her in all 5 elements despite there being a better choice. ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"But, that strength is locked behind only working for SGs.","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"She is not Clip SG, btw.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Should I pull or mileage this unit?","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"If you care about SR and have SG Team built, especially ToveTr and DrakeTr (and Doropity), then ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"YES!","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" You should get her. She will improve your damage in minimum 2 elements and up to 4 elements (5 if you don't have Arcana OG-Isabel). ","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"However, given that SG Team is a late-game comp only relevant for SR, this prospect may not be enticing to everyone, especially beginners or intermediate players. Therefore, you can choose to skip her if you are not planning to build an SG Team anytime soon. This might be a good idea as well if you're short on gems as the 3.5th Half Anniversary is coming near (end of April / start of May). 3.5 years already, huh. Time flies..","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Should I get dupes?","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"ArcanaFM has respectable damage, comparable to DrakeTr, and therefore can be considered a half DPS (1/2 DPS). She also gives the team 39% caster's ATK buff, and she is an Attacker. Therefore, she evidently scales with dupes, and given her relevance in multiple elements, it might be a good idea to obtain dupes if you are a competitive veteran swimming in gems.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Other players, such as beginners and non-competitive veterans, should NOT obtain dupes from Advanced Banner. You can get them from Ordinary once she enters Wishlist. ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"Yes, she will enter Wishlist.","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Kit Analysis","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Rotation Basics","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"ArcanaFM's rotation is pretty simple. When she Bursts, she gains Making Memories, a buff that allows her to trigger effects by shooting normally. She also buffs every SG in the team ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"(except herself)","marks":[{"type":"italic"},{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" with ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"+55% ATK DMG for 10s","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":". Making Memories ends whenever Full Burst ends, so it can be extended definitely (and indefinitely) by delaying Full Burst, not triggering Full Burst at all (not that you should do this), or extending it with BSoda.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"When Making Memories is active, her basic attacks trigger special effects in a cycle, similar to SBS's. During a cycle:","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The 2nd shot refills her ammo by +6.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The 4th shot gains her a stack of Happy Memories, which increases pellet count by +1 (useless most of the time except for breaking hitcount projectiles), up to +3.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"It also activates the second part of S1, giving her a stack of Snapshots of Youth, increasing her normal attack damage multiplier by +10% (multiplicative), up to +30%.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The 6th shot obtains her a stack of Precious Memories, giving +2.49% ATK, up to +7.47%.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"After the 6th shot, the cycle repeats, i.e. she will recover ammo after the next 2 shots. Therefore:","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Ammo refill: 2nd, 8th, 14th, 20th, …","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Happy Memories: 4th, 10th, 16th, …","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Precious Memories: 6th, 12th, 18th, ...","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"When Full Burst ends, all stacks of Snapshots of Youth and Precious Memories disappear alongside Making Memories. In exchange, ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"all SGs in the team will gain 13% ATK × Precious Memories stack count for 15 seconds","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":".","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Key Inferences","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"ArcanaFM's ATK and ATK DMG buffs are what makes her powerful, thus maintaining their uptime and strength is important. To do that, we need to Burst with her all the time and ensure she gets 3 stacks of Precious Memories always.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"This is easily achievable with ToveTr, boosting her ATK SPD to 2.1/s, which allows her to trigger Precious Memories 3x and Ammo Refund 4x. Without ToveTr, though, there is an issue. At 1.5/s, you cannot reach the 3rd Precious Memories trigger. There are three ways to fix this:","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The first one is you don't bother with it at all. Not having 3 stacks of PM only cuts a small slice of her ATK buff, so just take the loss.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The second option is to delay the Full Burst to get a little more time shooting, but at 1.5/s, you are basically lengthening your rotations by +2s each, which is not ideal and will cost you damage throughout 3 minutes due to reduced FB.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The third option is to whip out BSoda because she extends Full Burst and guarantees you get the 3rd stack.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Anyhow, none of these are ideal solutions. The only ideal solution is to build Tove (and thereafter ToveTr). She is literally the best B1 in the game but limited to SGs only. We can therefore say that ToveTr has a higher build priority compared to ArcanaFM and that building ArcanaFM without ToveTr is less profitable.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"We also want to mention that ArcanaFM refills +6 ammo every 6 shots during Burst, and her Burst Skill reloads +2 ammo instantly. This makes her not need Max Ammo lines. You are always guaranteed to have her shooting forever during Burst. ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"If ArcanaFM is in reload animation upon using Burst, manual and cancel the reload prematurely by shooting.","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Additionally, if you equip Bastion, she will actually recharge ammo throughout Burst, capping her magazine and preventing her from reloading outside Burst.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Another of ArcanaFM's abilities is screen wipe. Especially with Tove, her screen wipe can help eliminate mobs and projectiles. It is not as frequent as Nayuta's, but against some bosses, her screen wipe can help improve damage by allowing you not to manually shoot at the projectiles.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Tier List & Usage Analysis","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Campaign: B","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"It's hard to rate her higher because she only works for SGs, and SGs are not particularly good at long range or penetrating terrain. However, her buffs for SGs are good enough, and she has a wipe that can help clear the screen, so we are placing her in the same rank as ToveTr — B.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Bossing: S","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Her usefulness sits below Tove (because she needs Tove for maximum performance), but she is as crucial as Tove. If not for her limited synergy with SGs, she would have been ranked higher.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"In short, ArcanaFM is SG's new best ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"non-specialized","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" B2 buffer. Nayuta offers healing and stable long-range damage, as well as more frequent screen wipes, whereas ArcanaFM buffs the team better (thus more team damage unless Nayuta's niches are desired). review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Nothing beats a red-headed girl in an iconic dauntless red suit. Asuka Langley visits this world with her comrades, popping the champagne of collaboration between Shift Up and EVA. Asuka is a B3 Attacker from the Abnormal faction, armed with a phenomenal skillset that can greatly boost her own ATK, Elemental DMG, ATK DMG, as well as Hit Rate. Not only that, she can also buff the Core Damage of Fire Code allies. All these, on top of her built-in Pierce and Lifesteal, will make her a formidable foe, a worthy contender to the once reigning drunken queen.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Simply put, Asuka is a resilient character with both offense and support capabilities. When it comes to DPS, she has a decent output, ranging between 75~95% of Alice (4 shots/s) depending on what supports she is paired with. This is because different DPS favor different supports. She is relatively independent since she has already provided herself with a multitude of buffs, but at the same time she is less scalable than most DPS due to her damage coming from enhancements rather than multiplier. She shines brighter against Wind enemies and enemies with a persistent core. However, ironically, her Core Damage buff is more profitable for her teammates, since she herself does not have perfect accuracy 24/7, which brings us to...","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"One more thing that sets her miles ahead of her competitors is her capability of strengthening the Core Damage of Fire Code allies, albeit a bit niché since Shift Up has lately been stingy on the endurance of cores. It is still one rare buff with barely any dilution and one of the best buffs available in the market right now. Nikkes like Alice and Modernia (and Rei) will rejoice, since the buff automatically activates for everyone upon entering Full Burst!Her supportive side! Which we believe is what makes Asuka, Asuka. It is the star of the show and what sets her miles ahead of her competitors. Sure, the effectiveness of Core Damage buff hinges on whether the enemy has a persistent core, but it does not change the fact that it is a rare buff with barely any dilution. Nikkes like Alice, Modernia, and Rei can finally rejoice, since it automatically activates for Fire Code allies upon entering Full Burst!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For Asuka to achieve optimal performance, you may want to pair her with an external Individual Shielder when battling Wind bosses (you want 24/7 uptime on her Elemental DMG). Besides that, since her ATK buff only activates when receiving a recovery effect, bursting with her first is almost always mandatory, except when you bring a healer. Without a healer, and especially against bosses outside Campaign, you are expected to bring a CDR to make sure the ATK buff remains online for as long as possible.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In conclusion, she is a great all-rounder, an exceptional unit that everyone must have. The SAnis with pierce of Fire Team.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We are certain that she will dominate the meta not only in this next Raid but also in future ones as long as the boss has a persistent core, so she is a Must Have. That said, she will be valuable for Campaign and has been verified by top pushers. When Wind enemies start springing up, she would be a great alternative. Her synergy with Alice and Modernia is simply indispensable. You do not want to miss such a powerful Nikke, and since she is limited, pulling for extra copies is encouraged.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Nothing beats the old-fashioned way of stacking up as much ATK buff as possible. It is obviously the only way to counterbalance the stat penalties of CP deficit and make mobs with high DEF less of a hassle (Mirror Container go brrr...). However, she has no wipe, so if you expect her to clean the screen, you might be disappointed. You might as well wait for Rei for that. Asuka's playstyle is similar to Alice's, in which her damage spikes upon using Burst Skill. She gains Pierce and can decimate multiple targets at once, and she will also help accelerate the next burst rotation thanks to her long-lasting Pierce.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With that said, do note that Asuka may not always be the one bursting first. When that happens, she will not have her S1 active till her rotation (if you do not bring any healer). Sometimes, we also do not bring CDR (if using RH B1), so make sure to track the downtime.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While we do not expect her to outclass Alice or Red Hood, she can easily overrun Fire-weak stages thanks to her built-in Elemental Damage. Her synergy with Crown will also make that Elemental DMG permanent! Together with Rei and Alice/Modernia, she can make these stages look like a child's play. Alice and Modernia are meta campaign pushers, and Asuka's Core Damage boost will overdrive them. We believe they can also be force-used for other elements too, but we will see more into that after Rei drops.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Boss (Solo) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Boss (Adds) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Otherworldly offensive and supportive capabilities that raise her to another level, which shoots up further against Wind enemies. Still an overall versatile profile that should work against most bosses with persistent cores.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her damage is about 75~95% of Alice for most players (4 shots/s). Excellent synergy with Alice and Modernia, making her the SAnis of Fire Team (and Rei herself does that too to some extent). Great synergy with Crown/Tia against Wind bosses to achieve 100% uptime on Elemental DMG, but there is dilution happening, so it might not be ideal for minmaxing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bosses that allow Pierce to shine through annoying shields and clustered parts/hitboxes will also elevate her damage. Lifesteal also allows her to somewhat tank attacks that target Nikkes of the highest ATK.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In PvP, she is a mediocre DPS. Her basic attacks hit hard, especially against the countered element (w/ ELE DMG OL). You can theoretically use her to punish unprotected Blanc, SBS, or Noah in P1 before enemy uses Burst Skill. Her performance is most similar to Alice. You can bring a healer as well to trigger her ATK buff early.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her damage is contained within her Burst Skill, during which she forces the activation of S1 and gains ATK DMG. This will make her function similarly to Alice that she will continue thrashing the targeted unit, but this also means she is countered the same way (taunters + immune/indom). One drawback is that she wields an AR, so she will feed Jackal/Scarlet, unlike Alice, but this might not be that of big deal since not every team has Jackal.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka overloads herself with boatloads of enhancements—too many in fact that we would say every common buff would feel diluted for her. They still boost her damage, though, with Damage Taken and Elemental DMG being way superior. Basic attacks determine her output. If infinite ammo is assumed and buffs are discounted, she would deal ~225% of final ATK as damage every second. Sure, this is not as glass-breaking as Scarlet's ~325%, but her personal buffs make up for it.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka's multipliers are on the lower side and thus are somewhat less scalable (and picky about buffs). You can still maximize her multipliers by ensuring that she keeps firing nonstop. Provide sufficient Max Ammo OL and buffers and pray for miracles! More on \"Gear Investments\" section.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 1 - You Can (NOT) Shield","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka gains shieldbreaking capacity upon entering battle, increasing damage dealt to shields up to ~600%. This does not affect Hit Count shields nor increase damage against Raptures if pierce is present. While we still do not know how the next Solo Raid will play out, we are certain that this would be invaluable against that boss. Specific bosses such as the Rebuild(s) and Land Eater and mobs who erect Shield/Barrier will also be undermined.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The second component is what generates her damage. As we all know, every unit needs at least some ATK of any form before they can deal decent damage, and ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"a nearly permanent ~97%","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" is no joke. Use Modernia or Scarlet as reference (both dependent on basic attacks). When deployed alone without any healer, Asuka will trigger this buff once via Burst Skill at the beginning, which will persist over the next 25 seconds. Without CDR, this is close to 62.5% uptime, but with CDR, it is closer to 80~95%. Not faultless, but you can choose to pair her with a healer for maximum uptime. Any healing counts as a recovery effect, but ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"the ones with duration are only registered once at the beginning.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Without a healer, Asuka will NOT have ATK buff until she uses Burst Skill. This prompts using her Burst Skill first before anyone else's, making Alice a less than ideal choice of pairing (but if doing so results in higher overall team damage, then the sacrifice is worthy). On the other hand, Modernia perfectly synergizes well with her since she does not need to use Burst Skill at all. In shorter fights where the first few seconds are crucial such as PvP, you will almost always want to bring a healer to preemptively trigger the effect.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Pay attention to positioning. Healers with less than 5 targets will still 'heal' units placed leftmost if everyone's HP is full both in PvE and PvP.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 2 - You Can (NOT) Resist","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka gains Elemental DMG whenever team enters Full Burst and she has an Individual Shield. Independent Shield is different from generic shield (Centi, Blanc) that every unit is given their own shield and the shield HP is not shared by the entire team. Individual Shield is only provided by select units, such as Rei, Folkwang, Crown, Tia, and Ram. Not many optimal choices for her. Thankfully, this part of the skill only gives Elemental DMG, which means it is only necessary against Wind enemies. For enemies of other elements, you can forget about the Shield requirement.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Rei only grants shield once during her Burst Skill, which means 10s of uptime for Asuka's Elemental DMG. This is not enough. You will want to pair her with an additional Shielder.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka also grants Fire Code allies with Core Damage bonus. This is very impactful, as such a rarely diluted buff will massively boost the output of Nikkes that can regularly hit cores, such as Modernia and Alice (and Rei). At the same time, it is also useless if the enemy does not present any core, but unless it is one of the recent bosses that Shift Up makes hiding cores and promoting the SG team, then there is nothing to worry about. Most mobs and Campaign have cores too.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"To emphasize, Asuka's Hit Rate buff from Burst Skill only lasts 10 seconds, which means this Core Damage buff actually influences Alice & Modernia more than herself. What does this mean? Well, her DPS is relatively stronger when boss does not have a persistent core. When boss has a persistent core, she will be an amazing support. However, if Asuka can consistently hit the core, then this gap is basically nonexistent.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Beware of dilution from Naga, who already provides up to ~125% of Core Damage. Overall, given a persistent core, she increases the damage of perfect Fire core-hitters by 27~29% when used alone and 15~17% when used with Naga. While this is trivial and pairing them both together is in no way detrimental—in fact, it could be the opposite—it might be an important consideration for minmaxing. Her supportive strength also declines significantly when Core is absent (important for Raids).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Burst - You Can (NOT) Block","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka greatly empowers herself, gaining Pierce for 25 seconds as well as improving her survivability and offensive capabilities through increased ATK DMG, Lifesteal, and Hit Rate. This is where her damage spikes because that ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"ATK DMG is ~150%","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" and Hit Rate will allow her to leverage her S2 better. Safe to assume that, at maximum level, that ~101.37% Hit Rate translates into","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"perfect accuracy","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", which means all shots will be guaranteed core hits. This is not something that Scarlet can brag about.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka's DPS is divided into two windows. Her Burst covers 60% of her total damage, whereas the attacks done outside amount to the rest 40%. This goes up or down depending on Core Hitting Accuracy outside Burst.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let's talk about that Pierce. It is potent against bosses with Shield that are not immune to damage when Shield is up, and it is also good for hitting multiple mobs or boss parts at the same time, effectively doubling or tripling your damage (or more!). But, one underrated side effect is that it also allows Asuka to utilize Pierce Damage buffs, like the one given by Zwei or Mari.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Do note that Attack Damage, Pierce Damage, and most other enhancements that end with \"Damage\" (except for Core & Distributed) all belong in the same group, which means they dilute each other. Fortunately, the Pierce lasts 25 seconds, while that huge ATK DMG buff only lasts for 10 seconds, so there is that—the window of opportunity! Likewise, similar to her ATK buff, this should have 80~95% overall uptime with CDR.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since the Pierce lasts 25 seconds, she can use this to kickstart the Burst Energy Generation in the following rotation. Aim where she can hit multiple entities at once!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The Lifesteal looks weak on paper, but given that damage spike, it may be enough to fully heal her. However, don't go expect to see her tanking all sorts of damage and sustaining injuries that would have killed a Noise. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Evangelion… again! They really need to push out new content and stop with so much repetition. Anyways, let’s get back on track. With some basic math, we can find that this Wind pair is actually even stronger than their previous Fire element clones - in terms of dealing damage. But how strong are they?! Let’s find out with our review for Asuka: WILLE!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka 2.0 is, in simple term, a DPS unit. Her job is to deal damage, and oh boy, is she good at that! Her skills are mostly tied to her burst, to the point that more than half of her kit does not activate outside Burst Skill. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"However","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", she still offers much more than just fair damage even without bursting. If we do not factor in external buffs, she does the same amount of damage if not higher than the all famous Off-Burst DPS Pilgrim: Modernia - but in the Wind element. One edge Asuka 2.0 has over Modernia is that she does not need a core to deal damage. Majority of her damage comes from skills that cannot core hit.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her damage starts ramping up insanely hard whenever she uses her Burst Skill, which constitutes 50% the total damage she deals, despite the low 33% uptime. Nonetheless, it comes with a huge setback that can only be neutralized partly by Rei: Ayanami (tentative name), whom we will call Rei 2.0 in short.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you want to receive a TL;DR of how stacked she is, Asuka 2.0 matches SBS in terms of DPS, core or not. At peak investment, SBS with Alice buff should deal slightly more damage than Asuka 2.0 with Rei 2.0 assisting her. Against Wind-weak boss, though, the EVA 2.0 duo will easily clap our current goated SBS + Alice duo for the reason that Rei 2.0 herself deals heavy damage due to elemental advantages. Not to mention, players more often than not don’t use Alice with her full potential due to extremely tedious clicking, which means that for the majority of the playerbase, if they find a way to add Burst Generation to the team, this Wind Asuka-Rei duo is simply better than SBS-Alice duo for at least 4 out of 5 elements (exception being fire).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Unlike other MGs, Asuka 2.0 packs quite a punch against mobs too, because her S1 will not hit one but two (and three if Rei 2.0 is with her) targets. Definitely a 2025 limited DPS!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I get this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Easiest answer since Rapi:RH: Yes, pull Asuka: Wille. She’s definitely meta. She is extremely viable in 2 out of 3 of the major contents: Bossing and Campaign, and is a bossing specialist mainly. She suffers in PvP due to its locked 30 FPS, but that’s about it. Not to mention, Asuka 2.0 is a true limited, which means she won’t return unless Shift Up can sign another contract with EVA, which is not highly likely.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"How about dupes? As will be mentioned later on, investments in her yield twice the value than usual. And since people will invest a lot in her equipment, she is likely to have tons of CP as well. What does this mean? While she might not be the right choice for all stages in high-deficit Campaign, the CP padding might make stages easier as that is basically equivalent to increasing the ATK of all units. There is also service in increased stat for other content.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Also, yes, she is definitely worth the golden mileage if you fail to get her with pulls. MLB is advised if you are competitive or a fan of EVA but she performs well without 6%* base stats up from MLB (or 4%* at 2 LB). Be mindful that after this collaboration, we are guaranteed to be milked again with Half Anniversary looming around in 2 months. Brace yourself—a new meta age is here where Shift Up has decided to release power creeps upon power creeps. We definitely recommend saving mileage after this banner till Half Anniversary.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Asuka 2.0 is a strong unit to use in Campaign mainly because of how much damage she is able to dish out, and also because of the fact that she can provide a team buff when she bursts by debuffing the enemies to take more damage. Not only does she deal quite the same damage as Modernia as an off burst unit, especially on her strong element, but she also kills mobs faster if one can aim well enough. She can be used as an in-burst B3 too, and does not brick (i.e lower) her DPS like Modernia if she bursts. Instead, it further amplifies her insanely high single target damage and also manages to hit multiple enemies every second. It is also probably time to accept that the days of Modernia as main B3 in Campaign is a thing of the past.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While the current meta is shifted a lot towards elemental meta, we do not expect Asuka 2.0 to be used at the same level as Rapi Hood, Red Hood or Alice. However, we believe she is a suitable option even for neutral elements, and is an insanely good option for wind weak stages alongside the current queen of Wind: Scarlet Black Shadow. We really do still need water DPS for campaign Shift Up, if you’re reading this.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We will keep this short since we’ve already mentioned it at least 5 times that her DPS is super high. Definitely one of the strongest Wind DPS now overall, competing directly with SBS while also buffing her team's damage to another level. She’s so busted that we expect EVA 2.0 to become a staple team like Alice - SBS, Cindy funneling comp, or Fire Team. And when the boss has parts, she can even act like a splash MG. Mirror mirror on the wall, when will Shift Up release Skill Resets, release an iron weak raid, and stop releasing meta units every banner and give us a break???","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"C","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As an MG, Asuka 2,0 automatically has a low rating in PVP as she suffers from extremely low burst gen and tendency to feed Jackal, not to mention the lower fire rate because of 30. Besides, the cost till Lv. 7 is not considered high in late game. Eventually, it is a 10 if you have extra skill books lying around since after all it is a DPS increase.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Burst Skill:7","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Some personal damage buffs and a small nuke. Asuka’s Burst Skill has the same relative problem as her Skill 2, where when it is compared to her Skill 1, the damage increase is comparatively low. However, it is still a DPS increase so we recommend getting it to 7 since meta units have high enough DPS that the material trade-off is acceptable. However, we do not recommend getting her Burst to 10 unless you are a competitive player or are looking to maximize her DPS.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cube Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bastion is definitely the 2nd if not best cube for her because it lowers the amount of ammo required by 42% (at lv 7). Resilience is quite irrelevant because after bursting, Asuka is forced to reload at 60% reload speed reduction, so having a cube or not makes no change. And if Rei 2.0 could remove wind up during the other burst, then we don’t even need a Resilience Cube for this unit at all.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"What will be the best cube for her you may ask? Of course, it’s the new cube Destruction Cube (increases part damage by 30%). Remember, Asuka 2.0 can hit parts too and gain bonus damage from them. When the boss has strong parts, this cube will be the best on every character. Otherwise, select Bastion cube for this unit.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Doll Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The effect of MG Doll is pretty meh, but it gives Asuka a lot of raw stats, which are more than welcome. The damage reduction is very strong too (most people seem to overlook it), allowing some teams to run no healer on certain bosses (therefore Shift Up starts introducing heavy damage bosses again to sell their healers). You also want the CP boost from SR rarity doll too to help you push in Main Tower and Campaign if you plan to use Asuka there. SR 5 if you want to save materials. SR15 if you are looking to clear Kraken or are looking to squeeze more damage out of her during Raids…","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bready the Chubby Taste-Testing Cutie is a very competent unit against Water-weak Raids and is highly usable against Water-weak bosses in general. She packs quite the damage, although she will struggle to achieve anything remarkable in neutral elements compared to units like Cinderella, ScarletBS, Asuka: Wille, and RapiRH, who offer better overall DPS. She also requires certain support units to work, making her quite a picky eater, although you can say she's a bit versatile (she really is not) due to being able to work with two types of buffers and benefits from this exclusivity, but she has to contest her spot versus the common meta B3.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For Water-weak bosses outside Raids specifically, her performance rivals other competent Water units (such as QEQ, xLud and HelmTr). Two bonus points for her are that she relies less on core compared to QEQ and XLud and her shots can be spammed for Burst Gen, something not achievable by the other two. Additionally, her Distributed Damage has proven useful for Boss (adds) especially against Harvester AI where you can continue shooting at the boss without worrying about mobs.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She also works with SRosanna for her Lingering Taste route. Her Sustained Damage base damage is higher than her Distributed Damage route. However, since SRosanna is a weaker buffer in comparison to the Maid Duo, Bready is better used in the Maid team for higher damage output. In PvP, her performance is not up to standard and should not be considered.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I get this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PvE-focused players and those seeking a high rank in Solo Raid/Union Raid should get one copy, ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"but only if they have Mast + Anchor Maids","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". She will be needed for Water-weak Raids, and skipping her may negatively affect your score. Meanwhile, PvP-focused players can finally breathe a sigh of relief as this Nikke is useless. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"If you do not have Mast and Anchor, Bready is the easiest skip ever","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". She literally cannot function without them effectively.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Do we recommend getting dupes?","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Generally, no. While she does scale well on dupes thanks to her kit having a lot of personal ATK buffs, we do not see any value of doing that. Instead, save those gems for Half-Anniversary. However, if you are a competitive player or a gooner, then perhaps MLB is OK.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Should you mileage her?","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Absolutely not. We always recommend saving those tickets for high-value units such as Limited Collabs and Pilgrims. Don't waste those sweet tickets on not-that-meta units like Bready.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bready has AoE damage and clusters of mobs spawning at once in Campaign Stages can easily overwhelm her. However, in lower deficits or against Water Bosses in Campaign which require Distributed Damage such as Black Snake, she might just be one of the better options to use.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The disadvantage of using her and why she is not in A tier or above is due to the fact that she does not work with Crown alone, and needs Maid Mast or Maid Anchor to work. This specificity means she is not an ideal choice for Campaign, especially for heavy mobbing. Nevertheless, she can offer some minor Burst Gen Support and decent single-target damage through basic attacks. This is because she has a lot of ATK buffs that negate stat penalty. However, you will need to deploy either the Maids or SRosanna with her, which is not always ideal. An alternative unit for Water-weak Campaign.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Very good single-target bossing damage (equal to QEQ or slightly better/worse depending on whether the enemy has core, and also varies depending on how many ELE rolls you have on either of them) with some AoE support potential. Her damage is enough to make one of the best Water DPS units at the moment, not to mention the added bonus burst gen capability. She will definitely have a place in Water-weak Raids and can be used outside for Water-weak bosses (esp. Black Snake in Campaign & Harvester AI).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Future semi-support potential if they release a broken Sustained Damage Water DPS unit at the level of Cinderella (that doesn't have burst gen). Pairing her with Bready for burst gen + Damage Taken can be a good idea.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"E","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Not only do you need certain buffers to activate her skillset, her damage is also too low to matter. Can be used as a normal SR to generate some mediocre Burst Generation. Long story short, a Sniper Rifle without any skill in PVP. The only reason we put her here instead of F is because she has higher base stat than R and SR units.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

It “increases the squad's movement speed by 50% during exploration/non-combat battles”, which whilst not outcome-shaping was a great QoL skill to speed up dailies/clearance and reduce the burden of waiting. She is also the first Fire to have this skill. Because of this, she may be important for building mono-Fire Strike teams post-Beta, especially if you lack the current options Summer Anis, Summer Neon, or Winter Mica. Out of all units who possess the same type of skill, only regular Mica is obtainable all the time. The rest are seasonal, making getting XBrid rewarding for new players & serious team builders. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Campaign (LD): SS | Campaign (HD): SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"What matters in Campaign is ATK, ATK, and ATK! That is because stat penalty can only be countered by True Damage or more ATK. Introducing the 20s CD B2 with the highest ATK buff in history, Brid: Silent Track! The value of her ATK buff even beats Crown’s and Nayuta’s, but there is something you should know. ATK buff isn’t everything — while enough ATK = you don’t deal 1 damage, you also need other offensive buffs like ATK DMG to multiply your damage further and survivability support. This makes Crown and Nayuta better than XBrid because, at the end of the day, ATK isn’t everything. It’s the culmination of all.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"That said, XBrid is much better than the other B2 options when it comes to pushing under deficit. Sure, she doesn’t provide burst gen like Grave, Mari, or even BAde does, but Crown, Nayuta, and MastM also don’t give one. It’s not a problem — as long as you counterbalance it by introducing other battery units like Helm Treasure, Siren, Red Hood, Liberalio, or Alice.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Overall, XBrid is a valuable unit for Campaign ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"if you don’t have Crown or Nayuta","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", which might be the case for new players. She can also consistently make Wind mobs take more damage, so she might pull ahead in Fire-weak. Other than that, she (alongside Nayuta) is also valuable to have for 1-1-3 setups (with DPS flex) as Crown doesn’t like 1-1-3 as much as these two do. In Elysion Tower, XBrid can be used to replace AnchorM (XBrid - MastM combo) or as a solo B2 (1-1-3/2-1-2 setup).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Bossing: S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"XBrid is a valuable unit to have for Fire-weak. Let us explain. When it comes to Bossing, there are only two things that matter: presence in generic Bossing (content that requires only a singular team like Anomaly Interception and Campaign) and Raid (content where multiple teams are needed). XBrid can be used in these two, but her position in generic is more challenged. She can be used in:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"In Fire-Weak Raid:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" XBrid is a hard unit to topple over in Fire-weak. Damage Taken is always a precious buff, so she will never leave us for longer than one year, probably. In Union Raid, she can be run in your Fire team to save Crown/MastM for other comps.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"In Neutral Raid: ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"XBrid, despite her authority in Fire-weak, can be used in Neutral if she is paired with units that rely on ATK buffs or ToveTr/DrakeTr for brute-force damage. Note that most units are tolerant as to whether they get ATK or ATK DMG.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"In Generic Fire-Weak Bossing: ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"XBrid challenges the position of MastM. Normally, the team looks like Crown + MastM, but XBrid opens up the option of Crown + XBrid. You can also run XBrid alone, which might be good for certain teams that rely a lot on ATK buffs. Do beware of low burst gen issues. If there is a burst gen issue, make sure to use a battery in your team. The simplest one is Siren!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"As An Alternative: ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you don’t have the BiS B2, you may not have any choice other than using XBrid. Do compare her effectiveness in a certain team versus other B2 supports.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PvP: A","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"XBrid can be seen as a better Mari (somewhat) because her buff percentage is higher, and no one cares whether it’s ATK or ATK DMG in PvP. She is also a Shotgun, which can be annoying to fight against in Champion Arena because SG can attack P1/P5 depending on Offense/Defense status. She is also Fire, which is a dominant element in PvP and doesn’t suffer from increased damage from TVesti. Like DrakeTr, she can also backstab enemy’s Wind units in P1/P5. However, she can also be seen as a worse Mari because she is a Non-Clip SG and therefore feeds. Because of that, while we believe she somewhat has a higher value than Mari, her strengths are mostly niche, so we are placing her in the same rank as Mari – A. WHO IS THAT PRETTY GIRL!?!?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Yep, that was our reaction as well when we saw Centi’s Favourite Item Wallpaper on the developer notes. Unfortunately, that might just be the only reason to go for her Favourite Item sadly. Let’s overview her “improvements” together below, to see why that is.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"},{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Disclaimer 1: As of the release of this guide, Shift Up have put up a notice saying “Centi’s skill descriptions are inconsistent with the actual effects.” This can have two interpretations; either she is currently bugged and that she is supposed to heal the team when any ally’s shield breaks, or she is working as intended and the skill descriptions have been written incorrectly (i.e. in a confusing manner). We have reason to believe that it is the latter, and have reviewed her as such.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"},{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Disclaimer 2: Regardless of this possible bug fix, the problems in Centi’s kit will remain as is, just that there will be a silver lining commanders will be able to take advantage of, which can be useful for PvP and will return her rating to SS tier.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Centi’s Treasure does not aim to drastically improve her performance, as is seen in the other 3 favorite items released this season. The main net positive for Centi is that the way her shield works has changed. While her original form gave a ‘one-for-all’ shield, her Favorite Item version now provides individual shields for all allies. This is a huge bonus, since it is a much better protective barrier for PvE content. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, PvE is a very different game. While the new type of shield Centi provides is enough to activate Naga’s extra ATK▲ and Damage to Core▲ buffs, Naga alone is not enough. Centi herself does not provide any form of DPS output or direct buffs, which are an absolute necessity to have in the current Campaign meta. That does not mean she is unusable, however. Centi’s burst gen and improved survivability against one-shots because of her shields can still be effectively used in low-deficit gameplay.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Well, that was just Phase 1. Phase 3 brings practically nothing to the table, as it only buffs Centi’s max HP by a little bit (if and when she bursts), but Phase 2 is where the problems exist. Centi now receives the ability to heal the team, ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"but only if her own shield breaks!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" This skill is easy to misunderstand since Centi is technically making all the shields herself. However, since this heal only occurs if Centi’s own shield breaks, it is technically a very useless skill since the heal value is not nearly enough to justify this ability being a positive change. Not only that, since this skill only comes to existence if you get Phase 2, you also receive an awkwardly “forced” activation of her shield at the start of the round. This interaction also happens in PvP, which is what the main problem is!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Remember, Centi is primarily a PvP unit. Her PvE performance still is practically the same as her original version by almost every possible account and situation! This forced shield activation is more of an affliction than a blessing! While the idea might have been: Even if the shield breaks, there is a team heal, the idea is not good enough since it only happens when Centi’s shield breaks! Maybe if every shield break healed the team, this might have been a more productive and positively imaginative skill. But since that is not the case, ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"getting Centi to Phase 2 is considered a bad thing in the PvP community! ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This is because shields are a bad thing to have at the start of the round, since they provide enemy Rocket Launchers with extra burst generation, which is something you absolutely do not want.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While this can still be used to your advantage in some cases (e.g. in a Blanc vs Blanc mirror matchup, you want the enemy to burst first), the restrictions and loss of flexibility is too much in our opinion for this treasure to be considered good. As such, this will be reflected in the ratings.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Should I get her Favorite Item?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"There is absolutely no issue in aiming for Centi’s Phase 1 Treasure if you are a PvP fan, especially since her wallpaper is extremely pretty! She really is such a hottie! ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, as it stands, we do not recommend going for Phase 2 or Phase 3 for her Favorite Item. Unless or until you know exactly what you are doing (i.e. forcing and fixing her in a team where you want to provide the enemy team with more burst generation), we do not recommend upgrading her doll at all.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"By far, Centi has to be the worst Favorite Item to date, since this is the first time we have seen an actual demotion in terms of usability. At least with Viper’s Treasure, her loss in PvP usability was countered with the fact that she became a strong PvE bossing unit. That is absolutely not the case with Centi, since her PvE usability has not nearly improved enough. We are only noticing that her PvP usage might become more ‘fixed’, less flexible and harder to properly use, even for the top players let alone the general masses who are unfazed by PvP.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Centi now transforms into a better shielder unit, but it might come with consequences in a stage she is already omnipresent in - Arena. Let’s discuss changes to her kit first, before diving into a short usage analysis where we will try our best to dissect Shift Up’s cooking.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Phase 1 - Skill 2","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cooldown: 9s","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"■ Affects all allies.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Creates a Shield equal to 7% of the caster's final Max HP for 5 sec.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Centi changes her shielding ability from an ‘one-for-all’ shield to individual shields for everyone! The skill is still on the same cooldown. However, it is infinitely more effective in dealing against multiple enemies in mobbing stages. The short cooldown also ensures that she will almost constantly refresh it every 5-6 seconds, thanks to her cooldown reduction for this particular skill that already exists in her Skill 1!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This ability to provide individual shields also now opens up a new partner for Naga! She is usable, yes. But not as effective as her competition. Be it as a main B2, or as a flex unit, Centi is considered dead in the meta even after the minor improvements that Shift Up have provided to her.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The pairing with Naga is a good thing going for her, but Naga alone is already not enough in the meta as it stands. She is almost out herself, that is how tough the competition is. Not only that, much better pairings already exist for Naga, some as good as Crown! As such, we believe that there is practically not enough improvement in Centi’s performance to give her a higher tier in either one of the PvE formats above her current normal version.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PvP: S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"},{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Disclaimer 3: Refer to our foreword!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Assuming Phase 3, Centi faces some disadvantages compared to other Clip RL units. While this skill can still obviously be used to good effect on rare occasions where one wants the enemy team to burst faster (or slightly faster) than their own team (for example, in the case of a Blanc vs Blanc matchup, sometimes), we still think that since Centi will be restricted in this team-build, and the fact that we cannot ‘turn off’ this Phase 2, it is a net-negative ‘improvement’ in her skillset and usability!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We definitely believe that this Favorite Item needs to be re-worked upon by Shift-Up.
