review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The Secretary to the King, Chime, is a loyal attendant who lives a scavenger lifestyle. She aids Crown both canonically and in gameplay. In gameplay, Chime serves as a Re-enter B2 whose kit revolves around buffing Crown and only Crown. She buffs her Normal Attack Damage Multiplier, ATK, and ATK DMG—that's a lot to ask. Let's be honest, the teamwide Max Ammunition Capacity▲ is probably inconsequential. This means Chime is useless without Crown, but when they are used together, Crown becomes a somewhat usable DPS.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Under normal circumstances, using Chime + Crown together is a waste because Chime only buffs Crown, but not the entire team. Other buffers, while they can't make Crown a DPS, can strengthen everyone's damage, which in turn results in a stronger team output. That said, it doesn't mean Chime cannot be used. If you want to chase the memes, Chime + Crown is actually usable in Iron-weak environments. Give Crown a prolific amount of Elemental DMG OL, and she will inflict pretty serious damage, especially if the enemy has a core. Will that make Chime better than other units? No, but she is usable. We think she might be usable in Iron-weak Raid if you absolutely don't have anything else—I'm talking about units like Privaty or Naga, who give great team buffs. Oh, wait, but Privaty is given for free! Well, that's not our problem.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Anyway, Chime + Crown is not something you'd use in endgame or even in the early game (unless you have Crown and you absolutely don't have anything else better). If you see a veteran running them, it's only for the memes—don't get baited. Not only that, if you want to make good use out of Chime, you have to hyper-invest in Crown's OL, which is not recommended. Arguably, there might be a very specific endgame use case for them in Iron-weak Raid, but it's rather unlikely.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For a Freebie 3rd Anniversary SSR unit, she is all right. These kinds of units are usually made not to be meta but to help new players break the 160 wall. You get a free MLB if you get Chime from the 3* Selectors. This makes her a target of Rosanna's dispel and all skills targeting the highest ATK. Use this feature, whether in tandem with Invulnerability or not, to protect your key units.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With that said, Chisato is just a niche counter unit for Attack, which only deserves at most B-A tier in our new TL. We decided on B because she is not as impactful nor flexible as A.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Gear Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As a mainly elemental Raid unit, Chisato wants first and foremost ELE. The final lines can be Hit Rate to help her reach farther enemies/cores better or CRT to slightly boost damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Chisato's True DMG is mostly from S2, and since S2 contains her coefficients, it is the most important. Whilst Chisato is unlikely going to be used with 2 Reload Speed buffers, it is important to keep in mind.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A cube that doesn't have such a profound diminishing return is the new True DMG Cube. Chisato doesn't have a lot of ATK DMG-category buffs, so boosting her True DMG will leave a noticeable impact. True DMG still gets diluted with more ATK DMG, but it's not like Reload Speed, which hits brickwall at 110%.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Destruction can be better than True DMG if Chisato consistently hits parts. This is because half of her damage is from basic attacks, and Destruction is twice stronger. On the other hand, True DMG has half its value, and since it doesn't affect Chisato's off-rotation's BA damage, it's slightly less potent.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Do note that, while cube selections are important, their levels are also too. If the level difference is too far, opt for the higher level as the ELE stat will overtake.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Doll Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you use Chisato in Raid, SR 5 is a given seeing her high ATK buff. You can go SR 15 if you want. If you use her in Campaign, which you likely won't, then SR 15 is mandatory for offsetting deficit and CP padding. Stat + Damage Reduction are also important in PvP to guarantee a successful Moran kill. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Today on the news: The beauty becomes the beast herself! Cinderella is an absolute monster DPS unit, one for the history books. Yet, her happy and much awaited release has been surrounded by an annoyance of bugs, causing even the monthly prestigious Solo Raids to be delayed! With the recent bug fixes, is she still shining as bright as she was before? Let us dive into what our combined heads managed to know about her so far.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella is a remarkable DPS unit with a versatile profile. Her PvE performance is beyond impressive, and her PvP strength is no slouch either.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For bossing, her coming is a chef's kiss. With the right team, she can out damage the current queens of DPS, Scarlet: Black Shadow & Alice, but the best thing about it is that she does not use the same supports as them (except Crown). Rouge and SAnis are her best partners, and they are likely inseparable for now.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For campaign and other mob stages, Cinderella performs superb in low deficits. Her auto-friendly gameplay paired with how strong her basic attacks are makes her one of the top choices to use in low deficit gameplay. She is able to one shot kill every small minion during full burst, and shoots at an insane rate of 3 shots per second. Understandably, this is a powerful ability to have for campaign. However, she does struggle on higher deficits if the element is not in her favour. This means that while she is still able to perform at a great level in electric weak stages, she will not be one of the top picks on neutral grounds. This is because some of her problems become apparent, which are largely related to her gimmicky weapon, which provides little to no AoE even though she is an RL unit. She is basically a single target DPS without pierce, and we hope to detail more about it on our Usage Analysis section. She is prone to some serious issues in high deficit gameplay that elemental damage buffs are able to revert due to the sheer strength at which Cinderella hits her bullets. In grave conditions (deficit ≥40%), she might as well not be dealing enough damage, especially since her AoE nuke can get split up in damage and will often randomly target minions instead of the tanks. When it comes to campaign bosses, however, this paradigm shifts. She easily destroys Electric-weak bosses for you, and given proper investments, she is currently setting new lowest CP clear records for electric weak stages and bosses.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For PvP, her being a B3 Defender with a powerful AoE opens up various creative ways of using her, from posting her as a P1/P5 tanker to sending her as a nuker. Cinderella is the only existing B3 (for now) that can one shot the entire enemy team without help from any buffer! Despite her versatility, she does not really improve on the existing meta/roster since the current requirement is of Supports, not DPS, so she is pretty much the same as other nuker units like Ein or Rei, although she will perform at a higher level than them in most situations. Her extremely poor burst gen is a serious problem, but her tankiness is well appreciated.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Thankfully, she is not as costly as most other meta units to build, due to the fact that her Skill 2 provides little offensive bonuses. However, her team is, and you will need to invest a lot in her OL and team, especially Rouge. Testing has shown that Rouge’s limit breaks, skill investments, and gear level contribute decently in improving Cindy’s overall damage. SAnis affects her damage too if you pair them together. Fortunately, the requirements for Cinderella’s OL lines and her playstyle are comparatively much less demanding and are similar to that of RH and 2B (somewhere in between). For more info, visit the Investments section.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella’s bugs have hence been fixed, and the intended design displays similar performance to her ‘buffed yet bugged’ version.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"How did these bug fixes impact her?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"It was a “politically correct nerf” because bug abuse is illegal, so they tried to compensate for it as much as possible.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In base form, without any Charge Damage boost from Doll, OL, and external units like Alice, the Burst Skill fix did not reduce Cindy's damage. However, if any of these three conditions was satisfied, then she would lose damage. Remember that Doll's Multiplier is a multiplicative factor, which means it amplifies other Charge Damage buffs.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, the improved accuracy for basic attacks was something we looked forward to. It did make her mobbing more reliable, as she can now hit targets more consistently.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"For bossing, other than QoL improvement from like accidental hitting of QTEs against Crystal Chamber, the answer will highly depend on: 1. whether core exists, and 2. whether the fix permits her to miss fewer shots and land more core shots. If the update did cause her to land more shots/core shots, then Cindy would see a damage improvement.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"One more thing: in the past, we stated that Cindy’s quirky targeting and projectile pathing brought only negatives. We were not entirely correct. In fact, it actually helped a lot when dealing with projectiles. Against bosses like Mirror Container, we were able to ignore the boss’s projectiles because Cindy would automatically destroy them for us. But now? You are forced to aim at them because Cindy no longer destroys them for you. Even worse, the change has also made some teams no longer feasible. However, Cinderella’s performance largely remains the same as it was before these bugs were patched, and the teams she best performed in before still remain meta.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Absolutely!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" There is no stopping you here. She is an excellent unit for Bossing, one of the best if not the best choices to use. Not only that, but her Campaign and PvP performance deserves a shout out since she can perform exceptionally well in low deficits, and can also perform at a superb level when it is her own element at higher deficits. Don’t forget, she does not even need a buffer to kill the enemy team in PvP! While her most proper PvE team can be expensive, it is very worth it and vital - not just Solo Raid tryhards, but also to players struggling with Interception. Even casual players trying to do better in UR and SR, simply because Cinderella can work effectively in neutral elements as well! She also excels against Mirror Container in AI and Campaign both, and those resilient Crystal Chambers in Campaign. If you are walled there, this is your chance. A very crucial unit for endgame because of her Raid, PvP and Campaign use (above Chapter 23).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Splurge if needed, but if available, we recommend using just your Mileage Tickets as the probability is abysmal. Remember to keep gems or mileage (ideally mileage due to the abysmal 1% rate of pilgrim banners) resources for Grave as well, since she seems to have a strong kit as well!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As for dupes, we always recommend getting dupes for game-changing Pilgrims like her. Try to get at least MLB if you have a lot of surplus resources, especially if you are a spender. Remember to also put Rouge in Wishlist if you care about squeezing out as much juice as possible out of Cindy.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Cinderella is a very good pick for campaign when under ~25% deficit.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" She is able to work both as a main B3 (which is a B3 who you burst with) and as an off-burst B3 due to how strong her basic attacks hit. Anything that her nuke leaves alone, she will clean up using her basic attack within a couple of seconds since usually she just needs 1 bullet to kill. She even works well when her B3 partner is bursting. Nikkes like Emilia who have AoE clearing but lack good Single Target focus damage, Cinderella is able to help her easily kill those tanky raptures with ease. She will help you progress fast at the start, as is tradition with these meta Pilgrim B3 units, and is a good target for rerolling since she has major use in the endgame (chapter 23+ having 4 out of 11 chapters as electric weak and 4 electric weak boss walls, especially Mirror Container, Crystal Chamber and Behemoth). Also worth noting is that Fire weak (11/32) and Electric weak (7/32) weak are the most common element weaknesses seen in campaign, and hence Cinderella may see decent use late game.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"However, for players who are looking to find a Red Hood 2.0, Alice, Modernia or SBS, Cinderella is a weaker campaign unit when compared to them in this bracket.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, let’s move on and discuss ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"some problems in detail since criticism is necessary when such a hard hitting nikke is placed lower in high deficits","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". Cinderella has two huge problems for high deficit: Her basic attacks, and her Burst skill's nuke. Firstly, her Basic attacks have no splash damage at all, and hence she has to kill units literally one by one. She is essentially a single target DPS unit with no pierce. In Low Deficit, she is able to one shot these raptures and quickly move on to another one. In higher deficits however, only if you have a good amount of elemental lines on her overload gear are you able to achieve this again, that too only for Electric Weak stages. Otherwise, she is unable to one shot these raptures, and has to often spend 2-3+ bullets to kill just one of them. Keep in mind that Cinderella hits 3 shots per second, which means when a wave of 10-15 raptures drops, she spends way too long to kill them. This is a detriment since the opponent raptures are not there to sit around, and will kill you since they need only one shot to do so mostly. Her projectiles take a while to travel and aren't instant hits like RedHood's or Alice's, and neither are they constant AoEs like SBS and Mod or even Ein are able to provide.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"The second problem is her Burst skill's nuke.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" While it is able to hit super hard when the amount of raptures on the screen is lower than ~6-7, it fails to do the job when there is around 12-15 or even more raptures on the screen, while units like Scarlet or Rei Ayanami are able to fully clear their screens, no matter the amount of raptures standing in front of them. Hence, even SS tier units in high deficit tier list are able to push through on more situations and are less situational compared to Cinderella, something that is not the case on low deficit. On higher deficits, since she targets only a maximum of 10 raptures randomly, Cinderella can actually get her damage divided up so much that she will fail to one shot in higher deficits. This is one thing, but another thing which is an absolute detriment to her use is that since she is only hitting 10 raptures, she will leave 3-5 or even more raptures alive! In high deficit, that is a death sentence for at least one of your Nikkes as they are able to one shot you.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While these 2 factors we mentioned above are key to why she was rated lower in comparison to other B3 Pilgrim releases in campaign (Modernia, SBS, RedHood), she is still a decent unit to use in campaign. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Cinderella still hits very hard in low deficit and is even able to perform well in higher deficits, given that the situation (ideally the element) is in her favour.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Situationally, Cinderella, Scarlet, Ein and S.Anis will replace each other according to the stage on electric weak campaign. Some stages might see none of them being used due to the sheer brilliance Red Hood, Alice, Asuka, SBS and Modernia are able to provide.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This should not come across as a surprise. We will try to keep this short since the answer is pretty simple to this rating. Cinderella just straight up hits super duper mega and insanely hard when there is only one target on the screen. She does enough damage to outperform even Alice's peak, and even SBS's peak! ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"She is just that good!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Only way to beat her out in DPS (considering all units are equally built) is if the top tier DPS units have elemental advantage or have pierce advantage over Cinderella! (but this means it is no longer a non conditional comparison). She is, safe to say, one of the best DPS units to ever be released for Bossing. She has lowered the bar required to beat both Crystal Chamber (who you will get tired of facing in campaign) and Mirror Container (both campaign and A.I), and is also one of the must-have units for Behemoth, the new boss. An absolute must pull for this reason. Crucial for endgame meta.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Do note that Cinderella’s basic attack damage is low! It deals plenty of damage thanks to her S1. However, this comes at the downside of not having noticeable damage to boss parts as they cannot be broken with skill damage. In other words, Cindy is a RAW damage dealer.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"It is pretty clear where Cinderella's main power in PvP lies - her AoE nuke!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" She hits SUPER hard, She is the only unit in the game that can one-shot the enemy team without any buffers! There are some pros and cons that we would like to touch upon here. Cinderella is a defender unit, which means there is synergy with Biscuit here. She can proc Biscuit's S2 and give herself invincibility. She can also snoop under the radar because of her class versus the notorious and only B1 DPS, Rosanna. Rosanna's nuke targets attackers only, and since Cindy is a defender, she can hide from Rosanna just like that. She also gets her HP -> ATK buff during full burst, and not at the start of the round like 2B's buff happens. Hence, her buff cannot be removed from Rosanna's cheeky dispel ability.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"There are only 2 cons here. One is that her Burst Nuke has the \"Attacks Sequentially\" mechanic, which we already saw in S.Sakura's burst. This means that Cindy needs a short interval to deliver the full hit on the enemy team. This is beneficial when compared to Ein's nuke in that it can't be taunted, but it is worse than Scarlet's AoE since the delay means that Noah or Blanc can successfully counter Cinderella teams even if they are slower by 1RL - well, almost every time. Sometimes, Cinderella does get lucky and lands a hit on a key unit on the opponent team before Noah and Blanc can nullify Cinderella due to Noah's AoE block or Blanc's indomitability. She can also rarely fully nullify Noah Burst even if both teams are 3RL, but this is a random event. It works similar to the process where S.Sakura manages to sneak 1-2 hits in the same speed versus Noah. If Cinderella manages to hit Noah first, there is a chance she will win.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The second con is that even though Cinderella is an RL unit, her Burst Generation is almost non-existent. Her base burst gen is too low and she is, in fact, one of the worst Burst Generation units in PvP, even worse than MG units! She can also only hit one opponent at a time, unlike other RL units, which lowers her possible DPS output and shows that her AoE radius is indeed very small.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Cinderella PvP Showcase","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Cinderella simply kills the opponent team","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{"uri":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_jkSCLoeWoU"},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Cinderella PvP Showcase || Nikke: Goddess of Victory ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"hyperlink"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{"uri":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cd5h8bqTDBc"},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"P5 cindy vs. 5x SG ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"hyperlink"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Cinderella’s Defender HP and Decoy HP showcased as she tanks an insane amount of damage against 5 SGs","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let's start with Cinderella's exclusive weapon, an auto-RL that continuously shoots projectiles 3 times per second once it is fully charged until it reloads. It deals 64.22% of final ATK as damage per fully charged shot. Reloading, even at ≥110% reload speed, will cause the charge to reset, forcing her to \"wind up\" again to maximum charge before resuming. This means uptime is important in maintaining her basic attack output, as it functions similarly to MGs.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"},{"type":"underline"}],"value":"### Concealed by Skill","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella’s basic attack damage is low, but her basic attacks deal additional skill damage from S1. This makes her basic attacks appear strong, but actually they are not. Since Cinderella heavily relies on Skill Damage and Burst Skill Damage, core shots become less important, and crit becomes more valuable. The low basic attack damage also makes her not able to deal any significant damage to boss parts, so when fighting Mirror Container or Crystal Chamber, she would have a hard time destroying the Glass Slippers and Back Crystals.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella's basic attacks are quirky. They can hit enemies or parts outside the designated target, and even miss cores against nearby enemies, which do not happen as often as before but still happen often enough to be relevant. This is an intended game design. This quirkiness makes her annoying to use in Campaign and brings some serious downsides. This forces you to play differently to accommodate these limitations.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"},{"type":"underline"}],"value":"### It Helped But Not Anymore","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In the past, these seemingly disjointed homing missiles would actually help you clear projectiles without you having to worry about them. Now, they do not, and you must actively shoot them. You can experience this QoL downgrade when fighting Mirror Container (like in Anomaly Interception).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 1- 2B or Not 2B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella's S1 is all about converting her final Max HP into ATK. Since Cinderella is a Defender, her base ATK stat is terrible, so ShiftUp compensates this by urging players to buff her Max HP instead. For example, a 100,000 HP with 2.71% conversion will give her 2,710 ATK. Without any external buffs, about slightly over half of her real ATK comes from her HP. Therefore, Rouge can be an essential contributor to her overall ATK and damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Do note that this buff activates upon entering the Burst 3 stage (before Full Burst, when you can select whose Burst to use). This guarantees her receiving Full Burst buffs from the likes of Maxwell but exercise caution when dealing with buffs before B3 like Mast's. We can also assume that her ATK buff is only present during Full Burst(s) and deactivate between them. Remember this when pushing High-Deficit Campaign. If you like stalling Full Burst(s), which ironically is the best strat sometimes, do not be surprised when she starts dealing 1 damage!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This skill also has another part worth mentioning: the extra Skill Damage on each fully charged basic attack. This is similar to Modernia's. It can crit but not core-hit and actually constitute a dominant portion of her basic attack damage. This makes maxing this skill your main priority.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 2 - Decoys Hide True Feelings","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Upon entering battle and Burst Stage 3, Cinderella creates a decoy (which can be viewed as a shield). This does not taunt, but it does absorb frontal damage for Cinderella (including projectiles but excluding AoE attacks). Levelling up this skill greatly improves the decoy's survivability, but it is not something most of us are really interested in, so let's skip to the second component of this skill.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"},{"type":"underline"}],"value":"### Decoy's Interaction in PvP","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Decoys are considered standalone characters and therefore take sequential damage from enemy Nikke(s) in Arena and may even provide opposing RL more burst gen.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The second part of this skill is what makes this skill useful. In short, Cindy gains a Max HP buff that stacks every 3 seconds as long as her decoy is standing. This does NOT expire even when the decoy is destroyed and is permanent. It takes 36 seconds to reach max stacks from the beginning of the battle. While the value is low, it synergizes well with her S1, providing her the necessary ATK stat to make an impact.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Burst - Reminder of the Past: The Anniversary Pilgrim’s Burst Skill Buffed","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella's Burst Skill is self-explanatory. It is like Summer Sakura's but, instead of applying DoT, it deals extra damage for each Beauty stack she has from S2. In other words, one strike with maximum Beauty stacks will deal 1365.92% + 28.9% × 12 damage, and there are 10 strikes in total. We are still yet to account for Full Burst and other misc buffs, and yet this percentage alone is already mind blowing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"},{"type":"underline"}],"value":"### What is Sequential Attack?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Sequential Attack AoE is a pseudo-screen-wipe skill that attacks one enemy after another. It follows a random order established at the start and rotates in the same cycle until it strikes X times. If there are 3 enemies, then Target A will be hit 4 times, and B and C will be hit 3 times. If there is only one target, then all 10 attacks will be redirected at that target.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[],"nodeType":"hr"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The first part of Cinderella’s Burst Damage got doubled in value in a bug fix which was causing her damage to be ×2 than normal. Hence, if you had Charge Damage buffs from OL lines, Dolls, and Skills (such as from Alice’s S1), they would now become much less useful and not be considered something to aim for anymore. In fact, this “politically correct nerf” might have caused a noticeable dip in damage. If you were relying on Charge Damage lines for Cinderella, you will see a potential nerf in her performance and should try to reroll them away for better lines.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Major Bugs (All Bugs have been Fixed)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bug 1 (Fixed)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This analysis was made after the bug fix on Cinderella where her basic attacks used to completely miss opponents on the screen. This has since then been fixed and had no impact on our ratings, although she still misses a bunch of her shots in campaign due to her bullet curve and ends up hitting buildings. They also used to sometimes hit projectiles, which could be a good thing or a bad thing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bug 2 (Fixed, Damage Loss was compensated by doubling her Burst Values, essentially giving same performance)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"There is another existing bug where the first instance of 10 hits of Cinderella's Burst Damage is increased by 200% (or even higher if you have charge damage buffs on her), which happens if you burst with Cinderella when her basic attacks are fully charged. This is an on-going bug as of this review's release, but it had no impact on our testing. With careful testing, we were able to figure out that even without the bug, Cinderella gives similar performance in both Campaign and Bossing. We are able to calculate that the damage increase to Cinderella's current single target damage is ~21%. We can assure you that even if this bug is patched, the ratings will remain the same, even in PvP due to multiple advantages she enjoys over others.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The projectile size was reverted to its original size.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bug 3 (Fixed, may still happen occasionally but it is an intended Game Design due to her Bullet Trajectory Gimmick)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella also has a current aiming bug where she will not core hit on near targets. We have confirmed that it is because Shift Up, in order to try and fix Bug 1, increased the projectile size, and not the projectile splash radius. After it is fixed, her DPS output should be improved for even more situations than it is already good in, especially for Bossing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Gear Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"You probably understand by now that Cinderella is a DPS unit even though she is a Defender. This means we need to focus on increasing her DPS output as much as we can. Since she has the HP -> ATK conversion, you want to fully level up all 4 of her gears. Yes, even her Boots since, unlike the usual DPS where you can leave the boots at lvl0 since they provide no offensive buffs, Cinderella does benefit from the slight HP increase from them.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, this is very costly. Most of us do not upgrade all her gear to Level 5. Instead, we leave her Boots and/or Gloves at Level 3 (they provide the least bonuses to her).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now that we know she wants a DPS build, let's focus on the essentials first. Cinderella shoots 3 times per second, thus she needs at least 30 ammo to shoot for the entirety of HP → ATK conversion buff duration. Considering she has a base of 24 ammo, she only needs 1 Max Ammo line. However, for convenience, it might be better to go slightly over.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The rest is just your everyday DPS necessities: Elemental Damage lines and ATK lines. Note that ATK >> Crit Rate/Crit Damage > Charge Damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Elemental Damage lines are better than ATK lines since Nikke Meta has shifted towards Elemental DPS for both Campaign and Raids. Meanwhile, between Critical Rate and Damage, Critical Rate offers a more stable improvement, whereas Critical Damage is more volatile, and depending on your luck, allows for a potentially higher peak damage, which is what some people like to do in Solo Raid by retrying over and over again — RNG crit fishing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Essential:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" 1× Max Ammo","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Ideal:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" 4× Elemental DMG, 4× ATK, 1× Max Ammo","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Passable:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" 1~3× Crit Rate/Crit Damage, 1~2× Max Ammo","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Priority:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Meta","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill 1: 10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This is where her source of her power is located, where her HP is converted to ATK buffs. Reminiscent of 2B. Focus on maxing this first to maximise your DPS.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill 2: 4-10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This skill is of relatively lower priority since it is a much more defensive skill. It improves her decoy survivability and gives a small Max HP buff which stacks to give a decent value, indirectly providing ATK buff since her S1 gives ATK buff based on final Max HP.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Burst Skill: 10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Simple nuke with super high value which can target 10 units at max. Very important to fully max out this skill, since it will still be where the majority of her DPS stems from. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":" Note: Shift Up has recently buffed this skill such that it does 2× the damage!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cube Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Cinderella’s interaction with cubes is slightly awkward. That is because she still needs to take 1s to fully charge her weapon every time she reloads before she can resume shooting. This causes her reload to be perceived 1 sec. longer, and since this is unaffected by Reload Speed buffs, the effectiveness of Resilience Cube is heavily impacted. Cube.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since Cindy's weapon functions like an MG and has a \"wind-up (charge-up)\" period of 1s, she always scales better with Bastion, especially in teams with two or more Reload Speed buffers","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Resilience is worse for Cindy. Unlike other DPS who gain a significant uptime boost upon reaching >109%, Cindy still needs to wait 1s after each Reload. Depending on how many Reload Speed buffers there are, she would lose around ~1% DPS. Nevertheless, the level of the cube is more important than this percentage. If your Resilience is significantly stronger, its increased stats and Elemental Damage will allow your Cindy to slap harder than when she uses Bastion.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Lastly, Vigor is a decent alternative that can amplify her damage through bruteforce HP scaling. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ah yes, the freebie SR unit in collabs that has but one line of useful skill but is locked behind a 40s burst cooldown while being a B1 or B2 unit. Shift Up should at least try to make these units usable in our opinion. Even making them a 20s burst cooldown B1/B2 would be enough probably for fans of these units. Regardless, a freebie is a freebie and we shall not complain much. Let’s move on to her skills.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Claire Redfield’s Skill 1 is a simple healing skill. When she shoots 3 fully charged shots, she recovers HP of 2 allies with the highest ATK. The value of this heal would not have been bad had the requirement for activating this skill was 1 shot instead of 3. 3 shots means that Claire simply heals too less and is not a satisfactory healer. She also would not work with Crown as an off burst healer since it is extremely rare to have a team where Crown is top 2 ATK in the team. Hence, this skill is useless.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While there are usually 2 parts of Skill 2 in past freebie units, Shift UP decided to keep it simple and useless this time. Every time you burst with Claire, she is able to provide a shield to all allies. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Flashbacks to Ram in the RE collab. Re: Zero though, not Resident Evil! :p","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Finally, the useful part of her kit comes with her Burst Skill. Claire provides a huge burst heal as soon as you burst with her, and that comes with a cleanse as well! She is able to dispel one debuff on command, a rare but a very welcome skill to have.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While Claire does not have offensive buffs in her kit, she can remove one debuff (e.g. Charge Speed debuff for Scarlet Black Shadow if the team is up against a boss like Thermite B) which can translate to a damage buff. Using a B1-CDR whose Burst does not have a lot of team buffs (like Siren or D:KW for example), it can help the team deal more damage for players with incomplete rosters! Not bad for an SR unit to have a use-case scenario, is it?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Note that Claire Redfield is a welfare unit given to all participants of the Resident Evil x Nikke Collaboration Event. She is unobtainable by other means, except through logging in and completing particular missions during the event.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"All hail the King! Long live the King!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The White Knight has finally graced our dominion with the perfect blend of beauty and splendor. Donned in majestic attire, Crown's descent fulfilled the promise whispered among all wayfarers. While her arrival was highly anticipated, she managed to ignite enthusiasm with her radiant kit. A noble defender, one can say, with the ability to taunt enemies and shroud herself with invulnerability, is an important addition to any teams. She can also greatly increase allies' ATK & DEF, reloading speed, and Attack Damage, making her relevant in all sorts of situations. All in all, she has successfully raised everyone's standard by presenting herself as the worthiest individual to inherit the glorious title “a shield and a lance”.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Summary","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give us a brief introduction?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Crown is one of the best support units available at the moment. With breathtaking offensive potential, and the special Taunt + Invulnerability, she will be paramount to many teams, from Campaign to Bossing. Her reload speed can be handy at times and will soon unravel unprecedented synergy opportunities. She will likely stay relevant for a long time and is a good investment.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Absolutely yes!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" One copy is recommended, at the very least. She will be useful for veterans & beginners alike, allowing them to overcome obstacles in various different ways.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Using Mileage on her is recommended, so maybe save your pulls if you're just aiming for 1 copy. Pilgrims have 1% rate up banners, so ideally you spend pulls on normal 2% rate up, and use golden mileage on 1% rate up.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We recommend 1 copy for f2p players. However, if you are a spender, we recommend pulling for dupes, since her Skill 1 is based on Caster's ATK buff. Not only that, Crown can prove to be quite a force of nature as a DPS. So she can improve her self DPS with dupes as well! We think MLB should do perfectly fine for Crown, with the added bonus of a lovely lobby screen. Core 7 for mega simps or super competitive players only.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Tier List & Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Crown can surpass Tia Naga, the current meta combo, when it comes to raw damage. However, as mentioned in the previous section, there seems to be special use cases for either depending on the stage & featured enemies. In low deficit, you should be able to clear stages easily with any of them.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Crown's performance does not seem to degrade with high penalty, and in fact, the shielding and invulnerability combined with taunt will be extremely useful for blocking attacks that cannot normally be i-framed. One concerning weakness that Crown demonstrates is that the ATK buff is only applied to units who use Burst Skill, whereas Tia Naga will buff the team equally. This becomes more apparent in high deficits where ATK buffs play a big role. Note that this recommendation is more relevant for extremely high deficit campaign (≥36%), and your mileage may vary. Regardless, Crown provides such a multitude of buffs that she is still at the very top in high deficit campaign as well!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Boss (Solo) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Again, insane raw offensive buffs. Priceless. Possibly the new team 1 in raids! She will be seeing unending usage in the top 3 teams in Union Raid and Solo Raids! Outside Raids, you always have the privilege to test whether Tiga or Crown will help you more. Its safe to say that Crown has already raised the bar in terms of high deficit Boss clearing, with more and more lowest clears on Campaign Boss stages appear to be with Crown, and not Tia Naga!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Boss (Adds) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"It would have been SSS+ if it existed. Now, the reason is because, while taunts are generally valuable against bosses with mobs, they can quickly spell a unit's death. However, Crown circumvents this by giving herself Invulnerability. This means, even if Crown taunts 1000 enemies at once, she would still take zero damage! The best part? She doesn't taunt for a SECOND more than her invulnerability duration (which is a big problem with Noah)!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Check out this clip on Mother Whale, shared with us by community member Raon Miru on Discord:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{"uri":"https://youtu.be/fb7nS7jLsK4"},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"https://youtu.be/fb7nS7jLsK4","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"hyperlink"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In an ideal roster, we will not be using Crown. Machine guns have poor burst generation in Arena and can easily feed Jackal & Scarlet. Even worse, due to the 30 FPS cap, Crown would take nearly 29 seconds to trigger the taunt + invulnerability. At this point, the outcome of the battle is most likely already settled. But if you can somehow manage a 2-2.5RL team with her, Crown won't feed Jackal - Scarlet much due to the windup of MG. Her being a Defender also means she can be paired with Biscuit for basic P1 tanking. Crown can be assumed as a sidegrade or a sometimes weaker option than Poli.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"heading-2","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Kit Analysis & Highlights","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"In the history of NIKKE, Crown is most likely the most balanced but at the same time broken character out there. She may not be the best DPS, but her presence brings too many sweets to ignore.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The Gatling Lance","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Let's first start with her special targeting system. Crown, unlike other combatants, has the ability to sense enemies that have \"camouflage\". ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"These are raptures that cannot be normally targeted by non-manually controlled units","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":". In other words, in order to hit them, you must manual your unit. Thankfully, this is not the case with Crown. She is able to \"see through\" this camouflage and can automatically assault these key targets, making it easier to coordinate attacks in a semi-piloted environment.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"You will be seeing these new enemies in Chapter 29 & 30, which are added in this update. Please be advised.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 1 - Frontline & Backline","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Crown divides your team into two imaginary files. The frontline consists of units who use Burst Skill in a Burst Chain, whereas the backline consists of units who don't. When Full Burst is triggered, all units in the frontline gain caster's ATK buff & reload speed. Meanwhile, the ones at the back gain DEF & reload speed. The percentage value of this ATK buff at max level is equivalent to 43% in Attacker's stats. What's stunning is that these buffs last for ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"15 seconds","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":", which means there is no downtime at all for teams who rotate fast. Buffs will still switch between B3, though.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Do note Red Hood does not receive 2 instances of frontline buffs even if she uses Burst Skill in Stage I and III.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Since these buffs are automatically activated at the start of Full Burst(s), this allows Crown to be used as an Off-Burst B2 (but why? Dont do that.). The ATK buff is particularly useful on units that normally do not have too much ATK when using their Burst Skill, such as Snow White, PrivM, Emilia, or even SAnis (technically a bursting Modernia too). However, it is still nice to have for units whose ATK is already oversaturated, like SBS.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The reload speed may not be prominent in units whose downtime is minimal, but units such as Alice, XLud, and Modernia can benefit from it to high degrees, the standout being Alice. It can also be paired with other reload buffer(s) to achieve the \"Infinite Ammo\" phenomenon, significantly boosting the damage of certain weapon types and skills. For instance, an Alice with Infinite Ammo is deadly because she wants to shoot as many times as possible during Burst Skill. Alice + Admi + Privaty used to be an all-time favorite combo and is the idea underlying this suggestion. The Infinite Ammo strategy is also highly effective on MGs because they need to wind up should they stop shooting for a long time. It is also awesome on units who reload often, like Scarlet.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"To put it in number, with lv 10 S1 and lv 7 or more of Resilience cube (reload cube), MG will never wind up as long as target is still available.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"hyperlink","data":{"uri":"https://youtu.be/JSpg2hWcFLQ"},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"https://youtu.be/JSpg2hWcFLQ","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"text","value":"","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Units who rely on last bullet hitting also enjoy any reload speed buffs because their skills will trigger in shorter intervals.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 2 - Impenetrable Fortress","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Whenever Crown lands 43 shots (so specific :D), she gains 1 stack of Relax, which raises HP Potency. HP Potency is a buff that multiplies healing given by owner from any source (For example, Helm or Rapunzel with HP Potency will give more heal - be it Lifesteal or Direct Heal). After reaching 20 stacks of Relax, she heals herself, taunts all enemies for 5s, and gains Invulnerability for the duration. She then removes all stacks, and the cycle repeats. Do note that her HP Recovery is indeed affected by the self-stacked HP Potency.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"It takes 43 × 20 = 860 shots to accumulate 20 stacks, and the stack clear is triggered immediately upon obtaining the 20th stack. This takes approx. ~14.33s of continuous shooting at 60 FPS. Reloading will extend the interval, so Max Ammo OL is recommended.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Whenever Crown is healed from any source, she also provides the team with Attack Damage for 7s. As the shortest interval between triggers is ~14.33s, the base uptime for this buff is a bit less than 50%. Hence, bringing a healer with ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"frequent teamwide healing, or targeted healing that can heal Crown based on position","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":", is required to maximize this buff's uptime. Be careful of deploying healers who only heal specific target(s), as they may not be healing Crown and thus not triggering the effect.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Burst - Better Safe than Sorry","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"When Full Burst is activated, you will always want to have your units shoot continuously without going back to cover or doing any unnecessary i-frame dancing. With Crown's individual shields that rival those of Tia, this has become easier than ever. She is also the only 20s B2 unit that provides individual shields. Aria, and Folkwang are stuck with 40s, while Centi's shield is single and can be unreliable at times. This can also activate Naga's skill 1 Core Damage buffs!","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Crown also massively boosts the team's Attack Damage upon using Burst Skill, and as we all know that buff is simply goated. You know what's even better? The Attack Damage and Shield last for ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"15 seconds","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":", which means with teams who rotate fast and get to the next burst within 5 seconds, they can be considered as permanent buffs!","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Keep in mind that Attack Damage buff and ATK buff are seperate buffs. Both are multiplicative buffs to the Character's Base ATK. Hence, Crown's overall buffs combine to do majestic damage!","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Overall Thoughts","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Our analysis shows that, in terms of DPS, she can potentially surpass Tia & Naga, and therefore it is safe to say that ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"she is one of the best support units at the moment","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":". Crown can also mitigate even the most lethal damage that would one-shot any unit. However, when team healing is needed or quick taunts are preferable, perhaps Tia & Naga will have an edge. They can also repair cover, whereas Crown can't. However, keep in mind that Crown is a solo unit, whereas Tia Naga are a duo. So pairing a healer with Crown is not only very safe, but also improves her Skill 2 attack damage buff uptime!","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-2","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Gear Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Because of the reload buff, Crown actually has an abnormally high uptime, which reduces her dependency on Ammo. We recommend 2x lines of Ammo for smoother shooting experience only, but you can always have more if you can afford.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Remember, Crown is a buffer FIRST. Sure she herself can deliver very good damage, which makes ATK and Ele rolls appealing on her, but you must remember, Crown is a BUFFER before anything else. Look for that Ammo, improve your real DPS, then if you still have spare resources, you can start upgrading your Crown.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Ideally, we aim for 2-3 Ammo OL, 4 Elemental Damage, and 4 ATK up.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 1: 10","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 1 is her most important basic skill, not only because it gives a huge ATK buff, but also the reload is so lethal on Crown. She needs exactly lv 10 S1 and lv 7+ Reload cube to achieve the no-wind-up MG, so always prioritize this skill as high as you can.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 2: 7-10","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Although skill 2 does contribute a lot toward the buffing of Crown, it can be compromised a bit. The last 3 levels will cost you 15 days of grinding Sim Room 5-C, for just 3% more Attack Damage and small taunting/invulnerable. You should finish it, but you can put it later if you are short on material and it is preventing you from fully upgrading your S1.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Burst: 7-10","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The bread and butter of her power. Maximize it as soon as you can. Amazing skill.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Cube Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Since she is an MG, Bastion would always be good, but don't be fooled! Crown also grants herself Reload Speed, so Resilience is actually very strong on her due to the lack of winding up. ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"Always use Resilience cube on Crown!","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"embedded-asset-block","data":{"target":{"sys":{"id":"FeNwPWOSfz4bVUWYEXAwp","type":"Link","linkType":"Asset"}}},"content":[]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Units like Crust are a blessing in disguise for players because they can finally breathe a sigh of relief. Every unit in the last 6 months (apart from Flora) has had a meta use in some way. This exhausts nearly everyone’s gem reserves. Thankfully, Crust, while excelling in her niche, is skippable.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Such an adorable girl should not be tarnished by the blood of combat. Crust is a buffer with cleanse capabilities that can be activated on command. She grants the team with either Maillard or Blanching status effect—which boosts their ATK—and based on the applied status effect, buffs their Sustained DMG▲ or Distributed DMG▲. In Maillard status, her Burst Skill buffs the team's Distributed Damage, whereas in Blanching status, it buffs the team's Sustained Damage. You can check which mode is currently active by looking at the units' status.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Crust also provides the team with an additional buff called Reliable Cooking, which slightly increases DEF. It is applied simultaneously with Maillard or Blanching and lasts 10 seconds. Due to its low value, Reliable Cooking seems to be no more than just a filler buff that acts as a hidden Internal CD for Crust's debuff cleanse, which can only trigger on units without Reliable Cooking. Since Reliable Cooking lasts 10 seconds, Crust's cleanse can therefore be triggered once every 10 seconds, which makes her the best cleanse unit.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In terms of performance, Crust is a highly situational buffer + cleanser B2 unit. When cleanse is not necessary, she is weaker than all of the meta B2 units, but when cleanse is necessary, she can pull ahead. Compared to other cleansers, she stands out by providing a permanent ATK▲ buff and a respectable 20s Burst Skill that grants additional ATK DMG▲ alongside a specific offensive buff. Even in the off-burst position, she can still unconditionally give up to 30% ATK▲, making her a good situational FLEX.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This makes her good for Union Raid against debuffer bosses and may potentially see light in Solo Raid. She may also be used in Tetra Tower to some extent, especially with Bready, as an alternative to the Rouge-Blanc or Blanc-Noir squad.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"TL;DR - Not good, not bad; just right in the middle","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":".","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I get this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skipping is the wisest choice here","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" . Regular players cannot afford to pull every unit, so take this opportunity to save your gems.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, if you are overflowing with gems and spend regularly, and are hyper-competitive in Union Raid, then you may find some benefit from pulling one copy of her because of her cleanse. That said, unless ShiftUp releases a new unit that deals a lot of Distributed Damage and fights over Maids as supports with other units, the chance of Crust being used in Solo Raid remains almost zero. We also do not recommend dupes.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We also received questions such as, “I pulled Bready, but I don't have Maids. Should I still skip Crust?” Now, the answer becomes more complicated.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Normally, you should not pull Bready if you don't have Maids, but rerollers and waifu route players present a different case. If you are one of them, then — while we don't recommend pulling and wasting resources on Crust just to make her usable — you may pull a copy to activate your waifu (we know how much Bready is loved by the community). Besides, if your roster is incomplete, getting Crust will definitely help you in Raids and make some use out of Bready, but is it better than just saving and waiting for Maids to come naturally?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Do note that this is likely the last patch before Half Anniversary. Saving gems and Gold Mileage(s) is the most sensible thing to do. Don't let ShiftUp catch you off-guard with a surprising double 1% banner!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Crust's buffs are versatile and niche at the same time. Her 30%▲ caster's ATK (that can be triggered off-burst) and 20%▲ ATK DMG makes her stronger than most cope B2. At the same time, she is not better than most meta B2.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, when Distributed DMG▲ is concerned, she can be a great alternative if you don't have a complete roster. This is most noticeable in Tetra Tower where she only competes with Blanc for the B2 spot. She is also the only unit that can trigger Bready's skills in that game mode. An additional advantage that Crust has over her competitions is that she is an RL user, which has great burst gen potential and is reliable in all ranges.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She does fall off in high deficit gameplay since the game is more demanding of meta units to be used to progress. However, we have a Distributed Damage dealer that is quite meta in Campaign — Scarlet: Black Shadow. This pulls her ahead of the competition slightly. She can also dispel those ATK Debuffer Raptures that are menacing in higher deficits, allowing you to ignore them and kill other mobs first, get debuffed, cleanse the debuffs (even from the off-burst position), then kill them. Or, perhaps use them as wave stallers?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Oh, and Crystal Chamber. If for some reason you don’t have enough MGs to kill its hitcount rock and must take the less ideal debuff route, she might save you.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Again, situational for that debuff cleanse. Not better than meta B2 when there is no debuff but may pull ahead if there is a limiting debuff like severe Charge Speed▼ (e.g. Thermite B) or Hit Rate▼ against enemies with core (e.g. Heavy Metal & Obelisk), or even ATK▼ (e.g. Crystal Chamber). Since this is more common in Union Raid, this tier is slightly biased toward that mode.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"One advantage that she has over other debuff cleansers is her flexibility — she can be used in the in-burst or the off-burst position. Not only that, her Distributed DMG▲ has a really good value, so she can be used effectively with units like Bready and SBS to cleanse Charge Speed debuffs applied to them.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"C","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Haha. The only skill Crust has for PvP is her 20% ATK DMG in Burst Skill. Yeah, nothing special. Just a B2 buffer. But, she is RL, so better than some random B2, I guess. Mediocre burst gen is often better than low burst gen.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Normally an executioner and now taking a different role, D: Killer Wife, with her newfound glamor, comes to surprise us with a dark tale full of moral dilemma and ethically questionable moments. An eyewitness to fate's shadowy whims, D: Killer Wife is yet another support unit to add to everyone's roster. She offers a unique buff that strengthens the team's Pierce Damage, alongside a substantial Cooldown Reduction that complements the other minor offensive buffs granted via Burst Skill.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-2","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Usage","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-6","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Campaign","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"A viable alternative to Liter, Dorothy, or Volume.
