","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In Low Deficit, Nayuta is a highly capable B2. Her AoE nukes, alongside her immense buffs, make her one of the best choices, comparable to Crown even. Whether you run her as a solo B2 or together with Crown/MastM, you can expect to climb into higher deficits with her. If you are a new player without a good B2 (still using Anis, for example), Nayuta will feel like a cheat code for you. If you already have Crown, you can experiment and see if Nayuta + Crown combo can push you further.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Nayuta's only problem starts as she gets into extremely high deficits, like above 40% where her damage now starts to tickle. At that point, team buffs from like Crown and shields and outright immunity will become relatively more valuable. Before then, it is fine to use Nayuta as a solo B2. After things get rough, you may need extra assistance from another buffer. This buffer may be Crown, MastM, Maxwell, Ada Wong, or HelmTr, with higher priority toward ATK buffers. Note that HelmTr is less ideal with Nayuta than with Crown due to the missing S2 synergy. And Crown + off-burst is likely a better combo than Nayuta + off-burst. That said, you only have access to Nayuta + Crown in Pilgrim Tower, so they might just be the BiS there.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Special mention: Crown Naga vs Nayuta Crown. This is not easy to calculate. Crown & Naga provide the team with an extra Core Damage buff that is insanely good with core-dependent B3. Meanwhile, Nayuta + Crown gives more ATK buff that can help offset stat penalty, provide AoE support, and synergize with all B3 (whether core-dependent or not). While Naga theoretically has the highest peak damage, Nayuta might be better and more comfortable. Core-dependent = units whose damage is mostly from direct basic attack damage, not skill damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Bossing: SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"❗","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"Due to Nayuta’s and Liberalio’s impact, we will demote some units in higher tiers to better reflect Nayuta's superior strength in the meta.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Nayuta is not on the same level as Crown, but she is not far behind. Her supportive buffs are weaker, but she makes up for them through healing and personal damage. Against Wind-weak specifically, where her damage is amplified, Nayuta becomes the best B2. Nayuta will also be one of the best B2 if a boss demands healing (shield is not enough). Nayuta also makes Boss (adds) look like a joke with her continuous wipes. Remember Harvester?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"It seems Nayuta is a can-do-all B2, but this is incorrect. She has a direct counter, and that is the lack of a shield. Some bosses like Kraken and Ultra still require shields because of how much instant damage they can inflict, which will absolutely one-shot and not give you a chance to heal. To solve this, usually people run Nayuta + Crown and trigger Crown's Burst (which is objectively weaker than Nayuta's) just before these attacks. Is running Nayuta + Crown smarter than running Crown + MastM, though? Probably not for some B3 or bosses (esp. outside Wind-weak), but if you don't have MastM, you don't have a choice. Crown's S1 will also make Nayuta hit like a truck every Burst because she is \"always\" in the rotation. That said, it is very, very likely that Nayuta will not be used with Crown in Solo Raid to spread out buffers.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As a solo B2 and for generic DPS (and against non-Wind-Weak), the power level should be Crown > Nayuta > BAde > Grave, unless burst gen is needed. For Pierce DPS, BAde/Grave might take the lead. In terms of duos, Crown + MastM > Nayuta + Crown ≥ Nayuta + MastM. MastM synergizes pretty well with Distributed Damage dealers. Out of all of them, only Nayuta can provide healing (and HelmTr and Naga if those count). Crown Naga may surpass most, if not all of them, if the boss has a perma core and you use core-dependent B3.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"You may need this cheat sheet in Solo Raids and Union Raids, as we will start seeing her being preferred over other B2s, especially Mari, now that she is old and has the cumbersome requirement of hitting a core. Just like Crown, she could be in the SG team, Cindy team (to break Wind QTEs mainly), flex team, etc. Nayuta also has synergy with MirandaTr for crit abuse, which may see use in Wind-weak, but tweaking your investments to allow this to happen can be expensive. You will need MirandaTr, a CDR, and ideally 2 B3 that don't give themselves ATK (MiharaBC, HelmTr, SSakura, Maxwell). In Union Raids, especially, it is very comforting knowing there is a Crown-level B2 unit for an element (i.e. against Wind Weak bosses)! This is huge since it frees up Crown for other elements, since she practically wants to be used on every element.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PvP: S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Nayuta's kit looks like that of a PvP Goddess, but in reality, her special traits are not so important in the current meta. PvP has been revolving around protecting the frontline/backline (from Sniper Rifles and SGs), but also the whole team. Some teams sacrifice protection for better offense (i.e. Scarlet team), and some sacrifice offense for better defense (i.e. stall team). The problem with her is that she is a B2 that doesn't offer team protection. She is only a tank. What is the purpose of her surviving but the team dying? Unless you are doing that to wait out Mihara's DoT, there is simply no reason for using her. However, she is still a better Makima, can buff the team, and has a notable nuke herself.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She can also tank without consuming Biscuit's charges, which can create some interesting triple-immortal teams. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If Jackal is the goat of B1, then Noah will be the strongest B2 in PVP. Not only does she block every single niche in PVP, but also she has one of the highest burst gen in PVP (top 6 to be exact, which is 2% lower only). Noah only has one niche: She makes the whole team invulnerable. Yeah invulnerable only so you can still CC them, except CC in Nikke’s PVP is pure weak (we guess they learn from their previous game), so Noah’s niche is actually the goat. It’s even more important in this meta where more and more nukers are introduced. You may live without Jackal, but lacking Noah can completely block you from fighting against some teams. Luckily we still have a cheaper Noah named Bay, but yeah, it hurts if you want to go serious in PVP and not have Noah.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The thief outcast of Master Hand who unfortunately missed out on the fun because ShiftUp randomly decided to launch Solo Raid one day earlier this time. She is a Water B3 DPS from Elysion who uses cards to inflict debuffs on enemies and collect buffs for herself. She can later consume these buffs and debuffs to deal additional damage. Her special move, Secret Trick: Rampage of Thieves, allows her to deal a good amount of Distributed Damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In short, she is weak. Her kit looks mint at first glance, but then you realize there are several glaring problems: low basic attack ratio, long reload times, skills requiring more than one target to be optimal, mediocre Burst Skill, and many other problems that will quickly surface the moment you start analyzing her skills.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let's first talk about her DPS. Mathematically, against single targets, she deals less damage than Scarlet. Phantom's low innate basic attack ratio, in tandem with her inability to trigger some of her skills, results in an underwhelming MPS (multiplier per second). The worst part is, whereas Scarlet can still be \"reinstated into meta\" by deploying SAnis with her, Phantom does not have an enabler yet. Even Bunny Alice, who can technically refresh her stacks against single targets, will not lead to a massive uptick in damage output.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Things become slightly better when calculating her damage against multiple targets. This is because she can naturally and repetitively inflict Calling Card and constantly removing them to deal Additional Damage. However, to continually inflict this damage, you must spread your shots among multiple enemies, which means she is far from being auto-friendly. A minimum of 3 enemies is needed, otherwise with 2 enemies, you are forced to wait 5 seconds between triggers.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We think the answer is a resounding: ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"NO","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". The major reason? Nikke's 2nd Anniversary is VERY close, but that's not all. Phantom is a non-limited character, which goes in our favor in that there is no serious harm skipping her since we can simply wishlist once she enters the default pool. What is even more in our favor is the fact that her use in the meta is, in fact, limited.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While she can be used in all formats, she does not match top units in almost any scenario, especially in ease-of-use. Sure, she might see use in Water-Weak Raids and obviously Elysion Tower, where she likely shines the most due to having many mobs. However, we believe she will not immensely improve your scores or the number of floors you manage to push. With Red Hood having set the standard in the first anniversary, the chance of the upcoming anniversary unit to be broken is extremely high.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you do decide to pull her because you are preparing for Water-Weak Raids and/or Elysion Tower pushing, we strictly advise you NOT to use your Golden Mileage for her, since she is absolutely not worth the Mileage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Phantom expresses interest in dealing serious damage in this game mode, but do try to understand that she is extremely hard and annoying to use. On Water-Weak Stages, phantom can effectively be used as a DPS and may even be used as an off-burst DPS. The idea is to pause spam and change your cursor position to hit different raptures, as shown in the video clip at the start of this guide. At the same time, you can burst with Red Hood or Modernia or SBS or Asuka or whoever you want to, but NOT Alice! The problem here is that manual intensive units will interfere with other manual intensive units. Phantom requires extreme babysitting (manual gameplay) to work, same as Alice. Hence, it is better to use units that don't require manualing alongside Phantom; some prominent names have already been told above.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"While Phantom is a good shout for Water-Weak Stages, with absolute perfect gameplay and build, she may even be a choice for neutral element stages. Taking everything into consideration, Phantom is by far the best B3 unit for Elysion Tower, and if you want to actually tryhard the tower, Phantom IS the way to go.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Bossing - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We will be judging this Nikke based on two major points: Boss (Solo) and Boss (Adds), with the major focus being on Boss (Solo) since it's far more prevalent and relevant. Phantom wants multiple Raptures on the screen to reach her peak, or well, reach any peak at all. She is considerably weaker compared to the likes of Ludmilla: Winter Owner and Quency: Escape Queen against Solo Bosses, all because of the fact that she cannot stack her thieving ability if only a single target rapture exists on the screen. That said, she should still deal enough DPS if properly built (skills and OL lines) to fit in a Water-Weak Solo Raid, so if you plan to tryhard, Phantom gets in your Top 5 teams.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She will not be a fit absolutely anywhere in Neutral Element Solo Raids, unless adds are extremely prevalent on the boss, which brings us to our other point.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Phantom closes in with her water partners (xLud and QeQ) when bosses with adds are considered, since she can now stack up her Thief's Dagger ability. With this, she can possibly (with highly managed gameplay and with enough Raptures on the screen, of course) reach to new heights, and compete with others in terms of overall damage dealt. Lucky for her, Harvester exists. Unlucky for her, Quency and XLudmilla with Liter and Crown are enough to reach Stage 9 on Harvester!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We've probably stated this before. From the average player's perspective, Phantom is not the Nikke you should be pulling!.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Phantom is not a good unit for PvP since her Nuke is too weak and her single target damage is towards the lower end. Her Skill 1 does not work in PvP since there are no Raptures. Because of this, she is definitely bench material in the overall meta. Even so, you may still use her as a Nuke + Follow-Up Damage Dealer with Blanc if you have an incomplete PvP roster.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

The debuffed Rapture has lowered DEF, whereas Phantom gains increased Hit Rate. Since this skill requires hitting a non-debuffed Rapture to stack, it is technically impossible to achieve maximum stacks of Thief's Dagger without having multiple mobs. Therefore, to be optimal, this skill requires hitting 2-3 different Raptures (NIKKEs don't count), but you still get bonus ATK DMG if hitting a Rapture with Calling Card over and over again. The procedure is:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Hit a non-debuffed Rapture to inflict Calling Card and gain 1 stack of Thief's Dagger. Hitting a Rapture which has Calling Card will not gain her Thief's Dagger but instead increases her ATK DMG.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Accumulate 3 stacks of Thief's Dagger.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Upon reaching max stacks of Thief's Dagger, up to 3 enemies who are inflicted with Calling Card will take Additional Damage, removing the debuff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The buff Thief's Dagger is then cleared, and Phantom gains Distributed DMG buff from Skill 2.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The kit feels pretty complicated because it forces you to switch between enemies to maximize its potential. On one side, you can keep spray-firing to abuse the Additional Damage as much as possible. On the other hand, you can also keep firing at one target to abuse the ATK DMG buff aforementioned.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In terms of Hit Rate, Phantom will need at least 2 stacks of Thief's Dagger to match Quency: Escape Queen's Hit Rate. This means against solo bosses, she will have less Hit Rate than Quency and thus not be able to core-hit as much as QEQ. Before testing, we thought the HR at maximum (75%) was great, but soon we realized that the Hit Rate basically cleared itself the instant it reached 3 stacks, so the maximum she can maintain is only 2 stacks. And EVEN THEN, she requires 2 different Raptures to maintain. Most of the time, it's 1 stack so she's just a worse QEQ here.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Using Bunny Alice, you can circumvent the need of multiple Raptures present to stack Thief's Dagger. Still, we will try our best to put out a short review for her.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"All of Poli’s changes to her kit can be described very briefly, as an additional skillset surrounding a new ability of hers called ‘Police Badge’.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"This ability creates a shield that protects herself and ONLY herself for the first 10 seconds of the stage, after which this shield expires. This is because shields act just like cover, and count as a hit.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Should I get her Treasure?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"NO. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Mirror mirror on the wall, who’s the strongest Treasure Nikke of them all? Well of course, it’s Privaty, because you are reading her review, not Moran’s.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Can you give us a short summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"What makes Privaty stand out you may ask? Well, at Phase 3 of her Favorite Item, it’s not just one thing, we’ll tell you that much. For starters, in terms of raw DPS, she’s now the 3rd strongest water unit. Secondly, and more importantly, her buffing power has substantially increased with the addition of two simple buffs in her kit: Damage Taken Debuff on enemies and Attack Damage buff to the team. With this in mind, she can technically be considered the 2nd best water unit. In fact, the best water team doesn’t even include Dorothy: Serendipity anymore, since Privaty will buff SW:HA specifically, as well as the whole team in general, noticeably more than the damage Dorothy is able to deal without Tove, pushing the Water element’s Bossing potential to another level. Have they finally fixed the water DPS issue after 3 years? We believe they might just have.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The best part? Privaty is quite comfortably the best FLEX buffer in the game now, beating out Maid Mast in almost all situations. Her buffing potential has improved to the point that she may even be considered a replacement for strong elemental DPS against non-Water bosses as well sometimes! For example, the strongest wind team right now is Siren - Nayuta - Liberalio - SBS - Velvet, but if you replace SBS with Privaty, the damage remains mostly the same. This is because, although you lose a lot of damage by removing SBS, Privaty will buff Siren + Nayuta + Liberalio to compensate for the damage loss. Note that this does vary on an account to account basis, with the prior situation assuming great OL investments on said units.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Apart from bossing, Privaty also improves her PvP performance drastically, as improved values of her AoE wipe at the start of her burst now require just 1 buffer to kill-confirm her enemies! Even if an AoE protector like Noise might be able to salvage her team against Privaty’s stun+strong AoE combo, we’d like to add that Privaty now owns a gigantic elemental damage buff (which also improves her prowess in PvE). This ensures that no Fire unit will be able to survive against Privaty, the only situational exceptions being Blanc’s indomitability and Noah’s burst.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Should I get her Favorite Item?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"YES!","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Absolutely YES! ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Privaty is probably the strongest favorite item unit that has been released to date. Her flexibility as a DPS/Buffer hybrid for Water Weak content is already enough of a reason to build her for most players. To further expand on her buffing potential though: Privaty can be considered the best off-burst buffer for any team! This means that she's practically meta in every element in both solo raids and union raids. Even in Museum, you are bound to use her against every boss for your high scores! In Anomaly Interception, she can be considered a top pick for the off-burst spot in every element as well, especially if you're early to mid game. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"But it's not just bossing. In the campaign, she is now a side-grade for Mast: Romantic Maid and HelmTr. And in PvP, her improved AoE is a serious threat to her enemies as well! Privaty is an all-around pick that would be an epic addition to everyone's rosters. Be it veterans, be it newbies, or be it mid-game players.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We recommend reaching Phase 3 of her favourite Item. However, she still excels in Water content at phase 2 as well. Only in Phase 3 will she beat out buffers like Maid Mast consistently though.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Phase 1: Burst Skill - Ele buffs, Improved AoE & Prep for Phase 2","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Phase 1 treasure, which only requires you to level up her SR doll to lv 15, will change her burst:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The damage modifier goes from 457.87% => 1407.64% (3x increased)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Give herself insane amount of Elemental Damage: 130%","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Give a weak ATK down debuff onto enemies (this debuff is super important for phase 2)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The phase 1 change mostly impacts her PVP value. Privaty can now be a wiper in PVP due to her very high modifier AoE nuke on burst. Note that this damage has a slight delay, same as Noah’s shield but not as long as Liberalio’s. The damage is not big enough to solo kill everyone like Lib, but she only needs 1 buffer to clean up everyone (unless the enemy also uses 1 protector to offset Privaty’s damage).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The amount of Elemental Damage buff provided is indeed big. At phase 1, however, Privaty won’t have any meaningful damage to make use of, so you can forget about this buff. Some may say it helps secure those fire Nikkes in PVP, but well, I don’t recall any solid threats in PVP that are fire and can tank the initial burst of Privaty (yes, Vesti is Attacker, she’s squishy).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Another interesting part of this burst is: It will give enemies a weak ATK down debuff (- 5.02% ATK) over 10s. At phase 1, it has a mild effect, probably allowing your team to survive a bit more but not much.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Phase 2: Skill 2 - DPS Improvement and Buffer Improvement","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In Phase 2, the biggest change is:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Last bullet hit enemy under Stun effect => Last bullet hit enemy under Designated Target (the ATK down debuff from burst)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Last bullet damage goes from 85.79% => 256.17% (almost 3x)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Last bullet damage to Designated Target goes from 1089% => 1687% (1.55x)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Original Privaty has an issue: She can hardly trigger her last bullet on an enemy being Stunned. It’s because stun is an insane effect which Shift Up balance her back by","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Every time Privaty bursts, she also freezes herself 1.8s!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Which means, you only have 1.2s left to manage the last bullet on enemies. With a fire rate of AR at 60 FPS is 12 shots/s, if your mag is higher than 14 by the time Privaty’s burst, she will never land that last bullet.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Well, the past is in the past. Now the condition is changed onto a debuff that lasts 10s, which means Privaty can land comfortably 3 triggers per Full Burst (with another reload buff like Crown or M.Mast). And you know what, both damage instances of S2 stack to a total of 256.17% + 1687% = 1943.17%. And it triggers up to 3 times every FB too.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Do note that Privaty CAN trigger her S2 3 times without another reload speed buffer, but the 3rd trigger won’t have any buff which is very bad. Also, if your device can’t maintain 60 FPS, her fire rate will be dropped to 10 hits/s which increases the time to shoot last bullets too.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"On her other FB (which she doesn’t burst), Privaty can trigger max 4 times but only the smaller part (because there’s no Designated Target debuff). To do this, you must maintain your ammo under 10 before bursting B1) The damage is not that important if you have to delay your FB too much, so give yourself a rest and just burst normally.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Also starting from Phase 2, Privaty will now access a strong debuff named Damage Taken. The value itself is not big (just a mere 10%), but it makes Privaty give 3 different types of buffs at the same time, making her value bigger than a lot of other buffers. This debuff will take effect the moment Privaty lands her last bullet, and because it lasts 10s, it means this debuff lasts forever (because Privaty only needs max 5s to shoot all ammo).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Phase 3: Skill 1 - The final piece of the buffs","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If phase 1 and phase 2 fortify her way as DPS, or at least Water DPS, phase 3 will complete her role as Buffer (You must reach Phase 3 if you want her to be a complete buffer). The change is simple:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Give 20.16% Attack Damage to all allies during Full Burst.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Let’s take a look at all the buffs Privaty provides:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"23.61% ATK","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"20.16% Attack Damage","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"10.01% Damage Taken","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"These buffs have effective buff power equal to 63.4% ATK/Attack Damage/Damage Taken. For your information, Mast Maid, the used-to-be best B2 buffer is now power crept completely by Privaty (unless you are fighting a very high Def boss, in that case the ATK of M.Mast still comes in handy). The reason Mast has lower hand here because Privaty has better buff uptime (M.Mast can only give peak buffs every 3 Full Burst), and Privaty’s damage as Off burst is still higher than Mast who is just a supporter with no modifier bonus (not to mention 25% of the time she’s stun)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Since Privaty provides 3 buffs at the same time, it’s pretty hard to dilute those buffs, unless you are Bunny Milk!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tierlist","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Campaign: SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PrivatyTr is an awesome unit in Campaign—we're not gonna lie. However, she has some weak links that make her fall short of SSS. To be clearer, let's discuss her performance from two perspectives (support & DPS):","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Support:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" PrivatyTr can be an in-burst and off-burst support. As an in-burst, you can use her as a secondary DPS or to form a funnel comp (think of Siren Nayuta SWHA PrivatyTr Crown). As an off-burst, she supports the whole team, especially your DPS B3s, similar to how MastM is used. PrivatyTr's direct competition in Campaign is MastM, so let's see if she's superior.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"MastM:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Due to stage design and how much important buff is during Stage Target wave, buffs that have a higher peak, despite oscillating intensity, are often preferred. MastM can do this through stacks. When the boss wave comes, you Burst with her instead of your B2 to unleash a \"focused\" attack.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PrivatyTr:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" PrivatyTr has a more consistent rhythm compared to MastM. She doesn't use stacks, and her Reload Speed maxes out immediately. She also doesn't steal B2's Burst Skill, so you can use Nayuta's Burst with her, for example. This makes her comfier but also less ideal for rushing Stage Targets. In Bossing, PrivatyTr's buff value is higher because she can apply Damage Taken permanently. In Mobbing, her Damage Taken is barely active, but it can be useful for taking down more durable enemies like Glasses and Stage Targets. Since \"focused\" attacks are a large part of low CP clears, PrivatyTr doesn't really shake the meta even though she can be the BiS.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"HelmTr:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" We don't think HelmTr and PrivatyTr fill the same role, although they are similar. Both can be used off burst as a regular support, but they have their own niches. HelmTr in Campaign is better than PrivatyTr or MastM if you need burst gen or heals (must Burst). HelmTr can also trigger Crown’s S2. If you need neither, the other two will be more performant.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Ada Wong: ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ada Wong buffs both ATK & True DMG of the Bursting B3. She is a great pair for TVesti & Ein, but for other units without True DMG, she can feel lackluster. Stick to someone else.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"DPS:","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" PrivatyTr doesn't have many ATK buffs for herself, so her damage under deficit can be... 1. That said, she has an awesome screenwipe stun that can lock down enemies. Together with Siren, and maybe Takina, you can stun-lock enemies for a long time. She can be used against Water-weak but requires a lot of ATK OL.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In conclusion, because these four have similar values and are often interchangeable, they should all be SS. Their pros & cons will decide which best fits a scenario.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Bossing: SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"To put her below SSS feels like a disgrace, you are not wrong, but let us explain why SS fits her better.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As a start, let's discuss PrivatyTr's strengths first. She is currently the best off-burst support in the game and can also be an in-burst if necessary. You can use her in ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Siren Crown RRH MiharaBC PrivTr","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", for example, or in ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Siren Nayuta Liberalio PrivTr Velvet","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". She is a support in both cases but in different positions. This is an important distinction because MastM cannot do this. HelmTr can, but her buffs are significantly weaker. However, she makes up for them through burst gen + heal, which proves to be useful for Campaign Bossing, and even against some Raid/Museum Bosses.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Whenever a comp doesn't need burst gen or have Distributed DMG, PrivTr will ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"always","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" be the best off burst. When burst gen is needed, HelmTr will pull ahead. In Raid, some comps will ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"always ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"need burst gen, and you can't work around it (think of UR's Liter Crown RRH Raven HelmTr). MastM loses her spot, but she remains the best support for Distributed DMG (so SBS & future ones). If you are crazy, you can combine all, doing something like ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Siren Nayuta PrivTr HelmTr MastM, ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"but this is only something that one would rather do if they did not have all the necessary DPS built and are in a tough spot.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"We have also tested that PrivTr > Crown as off burst and that Nayuta + PrivTr ≈ Crown + MastM (for non-Distributed DMG), so if you currently use Nayuta + MastM (non-Distributed DMG), Nayuta + PrivTr will give you a boost in Bossing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Another key point is that she can replace ELE DPS. Remember we suggested Siren Nayuta Lib SBS Velvet before? PrivTr can substitute for a missing ELE DPS. An oversimplification is that her effective contribution is ½ of the ELE DPS count of the team. In other words, when a team consists of ≥3 ELE DPS, you can replace 1 for PrivTr and still have a similar output. Let’s use the earlier ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Siren Velvet Liberalio PrivT Velvet","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" team as an example. Here, we treat Siren & Nayuta as ½ each and Lib & SBS as 1 each. The total is 3 ELE DPS, and removing SBS for PrivTr means -1, so 3 - 1 + 2 * ½ = 3 — the team still has 3 ELE DPS! So, good news to non-SBS owners! Unfortunately, this doesn't work if there are ≤2 ELE DPS, except if there is a hypercarry. For example, Raven against non-parts can be ½ compared to RRH on core. In this case, ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Liter Crown RRH PrivTr HelmTr","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" ≈ ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Liter Crown RRH Raven HelmTr","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":".","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In addition, PrivatyTr having non-caster's ATK buff is a detriment rather than a strength. Regular ATK buff means she supports Attackers best, but in some cases she will have to support Defenders & Supporters, which benefit less from her. That said, in practice, it doesn't really matter—what's important is whether she is used in the right team to avoid this issue; even with this issue, PrivTr is still one of the best buffers. There are situations where this weakness will be emphasized, however, such as in Electric team, where there are more Supporters & Defenders. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, what about Priv as DPS? She is one of the BiS for Water-weak right now. Second most valuable. Maybe in terms of DPS, she's not better than a Toved Doropity, but she offers more than just damage. The best comp currently is ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B1 Crown SWHA PrivTr SElegg","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", and PrivTr works wonders buffing a hypercarry like SWHA.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In summary, PrivTr is great. She sits in that nonexistent space between SS & SSS, not a hypercarry like RRH but also better than many SS since she is technically beating everyone in the slots she fights for. Her Damage Taken & Reload Speed are just too valuable to miss out on. Despite her deserving SSS in terms of supportive impact, we decided she'd fit in SS in the TL better because you still need those SS & SSS DPS to make her SS(S). In the end, she is not as impactful as a unit like Rapi or Snow White is, which is what makes the difference. She also fails to completely replace HelmTr. While being weaker than PrivTr in most cases, HelmTr still has her highly desirable burst gen & heal that no one will ever regret having for Raid & Campaign as they boost team building flexibility.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PVP: SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Privaty’s improved AoE wipe on her burst, as well as her extra buffs, AND her ability to deal extra damage - even after the stun dissipates - are all a part of the new pieces of puzzles that PvPers will have to pick up on.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She's not as annoying as units in SSS, but is definitely a force to be reckoned with.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":" ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Privaty’s improved buffs also mean that RL units like Emilia, LaplaceTr (and others) deal strong follow up damage. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Our tsundere princess is now a maid?! An adorable one at that and bashful too! Whatever led to this fateful twist, many didn't expect that, but it was definitely a most desirable one. As a maid, Privaty is quite the reticent soul, and that's also the reason why she only works with certain units. In short, she is a DPS B3 unit outfitted with an exclusive shotgun, whose accuracy gradually increases with each hit, and a repertoire of abilities that heavily rely on hitting pellets.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She can be thought of as a replica of Harran, who is used for her powerful screen wipe AOE attack at burst. PrivM can be thought of as an inferior replacement to Scarlet (who has a similar high damage AoE nuke at burst). She can perform surprisingly decent in the usual meta teams, but keep in mind that Maid Privaty will fall off heavily in high deficit campaign due to some major flaws. She has no self ATK buff outside burst like scarlet so her damage will fall off. This also means that she will stop screenclearing at high deficit. She cannot keep her attack buff stacked at all cuz she does not hit all of her pellets on enemies who are further away. To add to the last point, since she is not hitting all pellets her damage is reduced anyways, and her damage falls off even further due to less number of times her S1 is activated, hence she is reduced to having one utility only: Her AoE when she bursts, which is also weaker when compared to Scarlet's due to no self ATK buff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Raids","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Will probably see some usage in Solo Raid against bosses (like the current Solo Raid Boss: Crystal Chamber) with a giant body standing within SG's effective range. Superior against Water bosses. However, she needs Tove + Leona to even be worth investing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Elysion Tower","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PrivM's performance is mediocre in Elysion Tower due to being separated from Tove and Leona. Even so, her mediocrity is \"great\" for the current Elysion roster. Her screen wipe will be valuable in mob stages, but she will not perform well in boss stages due to the lack of Tove and Leona, which are usually the major wall in Elysion Tower. She can still benefit from 1 stack of ATK buff, which is better than nothing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"With a promising screen wipe if combined with Red Hood, XAnne, or both, offers an upgrade from Maiden's wipe in terms of pure damage. PrivM's Burst Skill boasts an astronomical multiplier that can easily benefit from ATK buffs. Sadly, she has a burst gen comparable to Poli or Naga, which can be unsightly. Regardless, she is remains to be a strong and viable choice for your 3rd team in PvP.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Differences between PrivM & Maiden:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PrivM brings a higher-damage nuke overall than Maiden's when paired with damage buffers.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PrivM generates significantly less burst gen (comparable to Poli).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PrivMy does not rely on hitcount to achieve maximum potential, unlike Maiden who needs to trigger S1.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Thus, we can conclude two things:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If burst gen is of utmost priority, and the hitcount requirement of Maiden's Skill 1 can be fulfilled, Maiden is a better choice.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If a stronger nuke is needed, and lower burst gen is not a concern, go with PrivM.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should You Pull","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Not that meta-changing right now, but if another unit is released to cover up SG teams' major weaknesses, PrivM can become more influential. Worth pulling/investing only if you have and can invest in Tove and Leona. If that applies to you, just wishlist or perhaps pull one if you love gambling.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Privaty: Unkind Maid (PrivM) offers something we've never witnessed before: a self-sufficient Shotgun that becomes accurate with each successive pellet (not shot, by the way)! Unlike other shotguns, she is believed to be able to rival the accuracy of Assault Rifles without any Hit Rate buff. In reality, this is not always the case due to its limited rate of fire. The accuracy cap is reached the instant she fires, but it will have already decreased by the time she fires her next shot. Furthermore, this extra advantage also comes with a steep cost; that is, her basic attack multiplier is lower than that of regular shotguns, clocking in at around 182% per shot. Worry not, however, as her skills will make up for that.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 1","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PrivM's Skill 1 deals bonus damage to two enemies closest to the crosshair after she lands a total of 30 pellets. When triggering, any excess pellet count carries over to the next cycle. This skill damage peaks at 202.84%, which is not that substantial against a single target, but it constitutes nearly 27% of her basic attack damage and grows to 36% with the presence of Leona (in Full Burst). Against two or more enemies, this skill doubles in power, but for now there seems to be not much value in mobbing with her. It can be handy in Arena, however.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 2","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"An unrewarding skill with troublesome restrictions! Firstly, the reload speed value is extremely low. Unless you pair it with SAnis's or Privaty's buff, it is meaningless most of the time even at max level. Not only that, the ATK buff is difficult to trigger and maintain. Requiring 30 pellets per cycle, an unbuffed PrivM takes exactly 3 shots (2 seconds) to refresh the stack. The problem is the skill also lasts for 2 seconds only, which means she is stuck at 1 stack forever! This can easily be mitigated with Tove or Leona, who provides ATK Speed and Increased Pellet Count respectively. ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Be warned that she can still instantly lose all stacks whenever she reloads for a long time during Full Burst.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Either Tove or Leona alone is enough to allow PrivM to increase her S2 stacks. However, Tove's ATK Speed is unreliable, whereas Leona's buff is simply weaker than Tove's. Ideally, you want to deploy both at the same time, as it will also accelerate the stacking process.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"When triggering the ATK component, PrivM also restores 1 ammo. This amounts to 2x ammo efficiency when coupled with Leona or 1.5x without. To put simply, each ammo may contribute to 2 shots. This is the most important part of her skill, as it helps her avoid reloading, which in turn resets the aforementioned stacks.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Burst","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Arrives with a powerful screen wipe that has a high multiplier (no ATK buff, though). Then, for the next 10s, PrivM gains bonus Critical Damage and Attack Damage, which we identify as a rare buff that rarely gets diluted. But, don't celebrate too early as this 'awesomeness' belies its low value and is quite negligible seeing that it only triggers once every 40s (if no CDR). Thankfully, there is no gimmick nor other limitations to be cautious of.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Gameplay","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As opposed to her convoluted arsenal, PrivM's gameplay is surprisingly very simple. You just want to land as many pellets as possible at all times and ensure she continuously shoots during Full Burst + 2s afterward without reloading for too long (outside SAnis's/Privaty's buff). You can easily achieve this by ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"reloading before every Full Burst","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". Using Bastion and with Leona, you are guaranteed to achieve this milestone even at base ammo. Aim for optimal damage distance too, marked with a blue crosshair.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Similar to XLud, to maximize her uptime, you want PrivM to only reload once every Full Burst. Since SG teams rarely have CDR, you want to make sure she can shoot up to 20s per rotation, minus reload time. With S2 and delay taken into consideration, she should take around 2s to reload, so 18s is your ultimate goal. If Tove is able to maintain full stacks for the whole 18s and thus retain the ATK Speed buff, a total of 38 shots can be fired within this window. Since you can recover 11 shots during Full Burst (ft. Leona), this effectively becomes 27. To be able to hit this milestone, you will need ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"at least 1 Max Ammo OL + Bastion","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", with average luck with Tove. Should Tove lose stacks immediately after Full Burst, PrivM will immediately lose 6 ammo due to the reduced ammo cap. Do NOT rely on it too much!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"blockquote"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Assuming you pair her with Tove and Leona, you want to ensure that Tove's stacks are at 3 before activating her burst skill. This would allow every SG unit to benefit from her maximum ATK buff for the entire Full Burst regardless of whether she loses any stacks thereafter. For optimal performance, nevertheless, you may want to RNG that Tove maintains her full stacks during Full Burst as this is everyone's primary DPS window.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Gear Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As explained in the Gameplay section above, you ideally want at least 1 Max Ammo to maximize her uptime. However, this is not mandatory. It is in fact much better to aim for ATK and ELE lines, which provide significant contribution to damage. Acquire them as primary lines. For the secondary lines, you can aim for 1x Max Ammo or as much Hit Rate/CRIT Rate/CRIT Damage as possible. She can work with many kinds of lines, so she is quite RNG-friendly.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill 1: 10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Scales extremely well. Expect 1.3% DPS increase with each level, higher with Leona, topping out at 1.8%.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill 2: 4-10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Leave at 4 or 5 to save resources, otherwise 7 is acceptable for a minor damage increase. Expect around 0.6~0.7% DPS boost per level, which is quite low. This skyrockets if Full Burst extension by Modernia is used, in which case upgrading to 10 is desirable. Upgrading Tove's or Leona's skills first may bring more benefits.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Burst: 4-7","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Effectiveness relies on CRIT Rate buffs the team can provide, but expect an average of 0.6~0.7% DPS boost as well per level. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The charm of a fleeting life is the adrenaline-pumping dangers within. That is probably what the legendary escape artist Quency would say when she fled ShiftUp's confinement to broadcast what SMGs are truly capable of. Quency: Escape Queen is a damage dealer who can deal distributed damage and continuous damage through basic attacks. Wielding dual SMGs, she can speedily vaporize enemies and accumulate stacks, unlocking a cache of practical buffs alongside ATK & Hit Rate. Her Burst Skill allows her to strengthen herself further and perform a screenwipe, annihilating enemies outside range.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Quency: Escape Queen (abbreviated hereafter as QuencyEQ) is a competitive damage dealer from the Water camp that can vie with fabled damage dealers from the garrison. She is not Alice-level broken, but she should be able to healthily compete with the likes of XLud and Modernia in terms of damage, but there is bound to be ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"some variability depending on the stage design & features.","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" Against single targets in close range, the 30% damage distance bonus will take her DPS up a notch, but this is rarely the case in most content. She suffers from inconsistency at long ranges even with Hit Rate buff as she needs to hit shots to stack buffs. Missing shots can be detrimental. She has a screenwipe to help manage unreachable targets, however. Overall, her DPS in a conducive environment seems very promising, at least mathematically.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"On the topic of synergy, at the time of writing, QuencyEQ synergizes well with most support units. ATK buffs are diluted because she has many but still effective. Stack refreshers are not urgent because the impact is minimal (since stacks last too short for timings to align). Honorable mention to SMary for being the only unit providing Elemental DMG buff.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As regards investments, she is somewhat investment-heavy as ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"her S2 should be maxed as soon as possible","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" to minimize inconsistency (missing shots; missing core shots). It also stores all of her ATK buffs, which are crucial to providing damage and counterbalancing stat penalty. She also needs a highly leveled Cube (at least Level 7 of Resilience/Bastion) and ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"a properly grounded OL","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", consisting of ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"1~2× Hit Rate & 1~2× Max Ammo","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":". Depending on the theme of the comp she is in, this ruleset may change.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"When it comes to usage, she will definitely be used in","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Water-Weak Raids","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" and can be used in Campaign, PvP, and Missilis Tower. Her solo performance is incredible, but the lack of special connection with any support is the problem. Couples such as Ein + SAnis make a great combo together, and the Asuka + Rei + Modernia triad will always be deadly. Meanwhile, QuencyEQ does not have an exclusive support yet, unless Miranda counts. Even then, she is still ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"one of the best units against Harvester in Anomaly Interception","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":", making her worth investing in if you need T9M gear.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Oh, and one more thing, she is MANUAL-HEAVY and absolutely not AUTO-FRIENDLY. This is because somehow the game codes it so that, if AUTO-AIM/FIRE is turned on, everyone suddenly loses their eyesight and becomes more inaccurate.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her masterful manipulation ability has beguiled us into pulling her, so you should too. In all honesty, she is worth pulling, but anniversary is around the corner, so you will be the one making decision this time, not us. Quency being Water is a dependable sidekick for clearing content that is Water-weak since we do not have a lot of good Water units at the moment. That includes current and future Raids as well as Harvester AI. She also holds some authority in Campaign, PvP, and Missilis Tower, though not as much as the other recently released units.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, Anniversary Units are likely to be more broken, so you should always prioritize them first if you lack funds to get both. If you are a competitive Solo Raid player and are concerned about being handicapped in future raids, consider getting one copy.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"S","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A generally good unit for pushing low-deficit campaign but may not be beginner-friendly due to OL and skill dependency. skillAnalysis.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Kit Analysis","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"QuencyEQ is a dual-SMG B3 who fires 40 bullets every second, dealing 202.4% of final ATK as damage and consuming 20 ammo in total. Her basic attack ratio is not high but is considerably higher than the average AR and should be equal to most other SMGs. It has a higher core multiplier of 2.5× as opposed to the usual 2× on most non-SMG units. review.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Foreword","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Quiry is a unit with poor eyesight, hence her disappointing combat performance. Her skills are very niché, and even then the values are too small to even make a noticeable impact. She seems to demonstrate a special predilection for defenders, increasing their attack and critical rate via Burst Skill. She also increases the HP of defenders, but it is currently not that useful, except in the case of 2B. Yet, it barely provides any boost, and bringing another B3 would be more justifiable. Attack reduction may come handy situationally for some content, both PvE and PvP. Finally, the last part of her kit is her overtime healing, which is a lot, but where would it be used?","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Usage","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Her main place will be in teams where B3 healer is preferred over B1 or B2. This frequently happens in Solo Raids, especially if you do not possess all the meta units. While her kit may be lackluster, if she allows you to survive for the whole 3 minutes, you will likely end up dealing more damage anyway.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Bossing:","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" One potential usage for Quiry is in Modernia's team, where you run a 1-1-3 formation. Unless you run a healer in B1 or B2, a healer in B3 is often necessary for survival. In such cases, we usually resort to Helm, which not only provides healing every other rotation but also grants critical rate and ATK damage buff. With that said, Quiry can actually take over Helm's spot. The problem is that she does not have much to offer when it comes to offense.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"PvP: ","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"She might usable in PvP as a copium unit. Her immense healing on Burst Skill is a great addition to stall teams, but stall teams have one major weakness — SAnis. If you consistently have the edge over someone (CP penalty), then with the right units, she might actually allow your team to survive a full 10-second SAnis' Burst Skill. However, other than that, you should deploy her with extreme caution. Since she is a B3 unit, it means you cannot use the skills of other B3, like Scarlet, SAnis, Alice, or 2B. This will result in lack of offensive firepower, and the only way you can win a battle is through surviving longer.
