Other than that, it can be considered a ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"permanent","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" buff as long as the condition remains satisfied.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The ATK buff, while small, offers a nice damage improvement. Her attack range is doubled for the next 10s.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The nuke is affected by the said True DMG▲, but it isn't a delayed Burst, so it doesn't benefit from the 1.5× Full Burst multiplier.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Increases her attack range from 750 up to 1500 (scales with level). You need ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Skill Lv. 7","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" to hit all enemies in PvP simultaneously.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Combined with S2, this makes her an unstoppable monster in PvP because she becomes Emilia on steroids for 10s or an uber-buffed A2 with no deactivation risk. Since it’s a regular AoE attack, she is not directly counterable by Biscuit like SBS is, or by taunts/attracts like SAnis is.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The nuke is super-powerful for mobbing and PvP, especially against enemies with higher DEF because it’s True DMG, and can help with clearing projectiles.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Mathematically speaking, over 10s, Vesti can deal roughly 1 maxed Helm Treasure’s Burst per target. This is extremely underwhelming in single target (bossing for example), but it’s insanely high in mobbing contents or PvP. This damage alone, without any other buff, is around 3x HP of any tank, so even with Noise/Moran buff, you will still die against her without other protections. In fact, the only record of tanking against no buff Vesti so far is the Moran-Nero comp, and zero record if we throw another buffer like Blanc for example.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Gameplay Optimization","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"When playing in Campaign and when Burst Gen is critically needed, consider landing her volley of shots on areas with high terrain and mob density.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If her Max Ammo is not multiples of 4, consider force-reloading her by sitting on her after the final volley is fired. This prevents you from switching to other units and quick-shotting for burst gen, however.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"On mobbing stages, activate Burst Skill when you know there are a lot of mobs coming. Treat it as an upgraded Modernia’s Burst and abuse the increased range to kill as many enemies as possible.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"ordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Campaign (Low Deficit): SS | Campaign (High Deficit): SS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"TVesti in Campaign is a decent mobber, although her attacks come in waves. She has good off-burst damage, but her damage rises dramatically during her Burst, gaining extra range that would allow her to hit most enemies on screen alongside improved basic attack damage. Her Burst Skill also has a quite formidable nuke that is especially useful in High Deficit due to its True DMG nature. She is like a combination of Ein and Alice but with damage spread more around AoE, making her a better mobber than a bosser. The more enemies there are, the more effective TVesti is.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In Elysion Tower, she can contest the tower’s best mobber spot. There are only so many crowd-control units, Rapipi ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"(","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Rapi: Red Hood","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":")","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" and TVesti being two of the best. Privaty lacks output, and PrivM is limited by kit/weapon type. Rapipi and TVesti both have good AoE damage, but there is a slight difference between them—Rapipi has a weaker AoE but a better single-target while TVesti is the exact opposite. However, this doesn't necessarily mean TVesti is the better mobber. She is quite reliant on Burst Skill, and she cannot quickly take down durable targets. If there are 100 mobs + 1 elite mob, she would have a hard time killing that 1 mob without outside help. She also kills everyone—which sounds ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"italic"}],"value":"good ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"but can sometimes be bad. Sometimes, we want to stall by leaving one or a few non-key Raptures alive, like ATK-UP Raptures, but with TVesti, you can unintentionally kill them, whether you want it or not.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Does she need the Tactical Duo? Not really. While her damage is best with them, it’s probably better to pair her with more universal supporters unless the other B3 also benefits better from them.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Bossing: B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Vesti is not an ideal pick against Bosses for one sole reason: her damage is not impressive at all when against only one target. Her kit is just not built for dealing high single-target DPS. Since the major source of her damage is True DMG per target, it also means that bosses with parts don’t really benefit her enough to make her hyper-meta either. Her kit is just designed for mobbing in mind, where multiple enemies are hit by one shot, resulting in impressive damage. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"But, this does not mean that she’s utterly useless. She is still usable against Fire-weak and High DEF bosses if you force her to. While TEmma and TEunhwa are impressive enough in their bossing performances (against the current fire weak raid boss, Ziz), Ziz having 4 parts helps Vesti become the ideal pick for a Team 5 this raid, but only if she is properly built (i.e. maxed-out skills along with ideal OL gear lines).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Other than the current raid boss, however, it is hard to believe TVesti will find use in the future. If there is a hypercarry True DMG DPS, TVesti might join her and the Duo as a secondary DPS, but what are the chances? Or, she might just get dumped…","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"PVP: SSS","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"TVesti is insane in PvP. Someone who’s a combination of LaplaceTr (but Fire) + SBS (good continuous AoE Burst damage) + ReiTN/ReiA (preliminary nuke) + Emilia/A2 (5-unit splash) is nothing to sneer at. TVesti can absolutely, if invested, and if you nicely ask her to, obliterate anyone with ease even before Full Burst. As we described in Summary, she can be used as a hard-to-counter AoE DPS, an off-burst pressurer, or even a pre-burst sniper with/without other RLs and TEmma + TEunhwa, who can buff them since the zeroth second. Yes, the trio can be used in PvP!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"It’s just super hard to create a team to fight against Vesti, especially a well-built Vesti. For your reference:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"High % ATK OL Vesti + Emilia can kill 3 of your Nikkes before they can even Burst.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Not so high % ATK OL Vesti can be paired with Blanc and kill any of your team besides another Blanc team.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"80%+ ELE OL Vesti with any Cube Lv. 9+ (>10% ELE) will pressure Blanc/Noah in P1, P2 and P3 before they can even Burst.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"She doesn’t have any pre-battle buffs, so Rosanna can’t counter her like with 2B. Rosanna can’t even kill her when she has an SR 15 Doll.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Very flexible in team building due to her beastly firepower.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Scarlet and Emilia are weak against AoE block units (Noah/Bay), Sanis won’t get through taunters, SBS is countered by Biscuit-wall.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"And Vesti? She can really only be countered by another Vesti or Blanc.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"That doesn’t mean she has zero counters, however. A well-thought-out team can win against a defending TVesti team. For example, a Noah TVesti can be countered by Emilia + protected Noah. In this comp, TVesti’s first two volleys will be blocked by Noah, whereas Emilia’s nuke will hit right after TVesti’s Noah’s immune drops, killing them instantly, especially with Emilia’s ELE bonus.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-4"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Gear Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"In PvE, TVesti needs 2× Max Ammo (16 Ammo) ideally, followed by 4× ELE & 4× ATK. The last 2 can be CRT or Charge Speed (which overlaps with PvP).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"If you want to make peace with her in PvP, based on your goals, you can do the following:","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Around 20% ATK will allow Vesti and Emilia to kill any Attacker except Trina-protected Scarlet in P1, P2, or P3.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Around 30% ATK will kill any Supporter.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Around 40% ATK will kill everything.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Around 15%+ CS will allow Vesti to land 4 shots near 5 SG shots, which opens more team building flexibility.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Around 80% ELE + Cube Lv. 9+, she may kill any Wind Nikkes in P1, P2, and P3.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Around 120% Ammo, she can have 18 ammo, which can be increased to 24 with Bastion.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Our recommended investment is below. Be careful and avoid ammo counts that are not multiples of 4. This will brick her in PvE, but in PvP, it doesn't matter because you want TVesti to shoot as much as possible before the first reload (and hence Bastion is even fine). Unlike in PvE where 16 Ammo is optimal, in PvP, the more the merrier. ‘Reset Attributes’ is always handy.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Essential: 2x Ammo ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Ideal: 4x ELE, 4x Charge Speed, 4x ATK. ","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Passable: Crit DMG, Max Ammo, Crit Rate","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Priority: Meta (PvP)","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill Investments","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The main source of Ves-god’s damage is her S2, so put as many into it as you can. S1 is whatever since her basic attack damage is trivial. And her Burst has a breakpoint at Lv. 7 to hit all 5 Nikkes in PvP.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 1: 4~7","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her basic RL damage is terrible, making anything buffing it terrible too.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"}],"nodeType":"unordered-list"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Skill 2: 10","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her main source of damage.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"list-item"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"The modifier is insane. It equals Laplace Treasure RL attack + S2 Attacks. review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Snakes are ultimately scary, especially when you know they can be venomous like vipers usually are. However, there are some people that seem to be able to charm snakes... and are commonly known as Snake Charmers. In Nikke, there is only one known 'Viper Charmer', and he is commonly known as the Commander! Viper, while initially a unit that wasn't well received in the meta, has been a fan favorite for a long long time due to her personality and role in the main storyline. With her newly gained 'Sustained Damage' skills due to her love for her 'Honey' in this new Favorite Item system (which was released along with her 60$ Gacha Skin, duh), can she push through and become relevant? Let's find out!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary of this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Viper's Favorite Item improves her Base Damage by a lot. With high uptime and good value Hit Rate buffs, she is able to deal core hits with more efficiency than before. Alongside this, she gains the ability to deal DoT with her Sustained Damage ability in Burst Skill, and buffs sustained damage in her Skill 1. This improves her previously mediocre base damage by a decent margin, but comes with it's own problem that will be discussed below. On top of all of this, she also gains a 'Re-Enter Burst Stage II' skill in Phase 3, which can be a good thing and a bad thing for her. This allows her to be a pair alongside key Burst II units which may want to be paired with Viper like Leona and S.Rosanna, which are the 2 B2s you will probably see alongside Viper.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, while her Kit has indeed improved her damage, how does she compare in damage dealt to other DPS? In PvE, You can think of Viper as a Guilty but for Water Element. The answer is quite disappointing in retrospect for a unit that was given a Favorite Item. We think that the key factor missing in Viper's kit is the ability to buff her own shotgun's damage with high uptime and value ATK/Attack damage buffs, etc. which is something present in all other top DPS kits. It would help Viper gain a better footing in the current meta. While Tove is an amazing buffer for shotguns, and can make Viper relevant on some scenarios, in general Viper's performance will be more or less the same as one would expect Guilty's to be if she was a water code unit. Viper is definitely the weakest of all treasure units as of yet. In PvP, Viper still displays similar performance as her normal version does.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I get the Favorite Item for this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Before we get into this, it is recommended to upgrade other Favorite Items before getting Viper's treasure. However, you can definitely think of use-case scenarios for which Viper can be a choice to upgrade. This comes down to a simple question. Are you competitive in Raids and PvP? Viper has a chance of being used against Water Weak Solo Bosses, and will fit in teams just like Guilty fits in teams against Wind Weak Solo Raid bosses occasionally. Another use case is definitely in PvP. If you are using her somewhere, especially in PVP as a Burst Gen filler unit, then upgrading her can be a choice as she will still do whatever she's supposed to do, but deal more damage thanks to Favorite Item.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"One thing to note is the fact that her Re-Enter Burst Stage II skill is a good thing for PvE, but a bad thing for PvP. In PvE, you would rather prefer to Burst with someone else alongside Viper since Viper's Burst Skill is a very selfish skill, whereas meta B2s tend to buff the teams damage. Hence, for PvE content, you would want Phase 3 Favorite Item.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, in some team comps in PvP, Viper is used as a solo Burst 2 unit, and in those cases you DO NOT want to upgrade her Favorite Item to Phase 3 since it will break team composition. Viper is also used as a sacrifice in some strats, for example in teams alongside xAnne and/or Rosanna, where there are two caveats: Firstly, Viper bursting would delay the Burst speed of the team. Secondly, Viper not dying due to the extra tankiness provided by SR dolls can lead to the whole team comp not working anyways. Re-Enter Burst Stage units are not considered as ideal units in PvP.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

review.raw: {"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"A closure to the studious trio, Zwei from Elysion embarks on her military journey as a Supporter that can continuously repair the team's cover HP and provide Pierce Damage buffs. She can also transform her weapon into a one-shot rifle that fires a compressed laser in a straight line, penetrating enemies. Besides her special weapon, her signature dual shotguns are one of a kind, but will that translate into greater power?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Zwei is a highly situational unit with no solid foothold. Design wise, her kit's foundation is to buff pierce damage dealers, especially nukes such as Snow White's or Maxwell's. From our perspective, she is intentionally made to be a filler unit as her performance seems to lag behind most if not all meta units. Or, if she does somehow become performant, she will be far from versatile and unprofitable for most players. Despite this, she may have some uses for endgame players, but do note that she is extremely Raid-focused with some hints of presence in Elysion Tower. Her objective is strictly for damage min-maxxing.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Objectively, her cover repair is nice, which can be considered a Healing Effect for the team, so ideally you should not need to run healers anymore (assuming your cover can sustain). This can be helpful for clearing Elysion Tower when Cover HP is the sole formula for success. However, why use Zwei when Marciana's healing is more reliable and much easier to use for the vast majority of stages? We also have Diesel (Treasure), who is already a superb alternative. Sure, Zwei pairs better with Guillotine, but at the same time investing in Guillotine for just Tower is impractical.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Now, as for her Pierce Damage, it is huge, but it is only effective for one shot and whatever is after that will only be subject to half of its maximum strength. Snow White and Maxwell are pretty much the only two units that can capitalize on this, and for others, there are usually better options (like D:Wife, Liter, FrimaT for Laplace etc).","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"All things considered, Zwei's immediate impact is weak, and she will likely only fancy collectors.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Should I pull this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Only pull one copy if you are a competitive Solo Raid player, and that too only if you fancy using Snow White teams. Otherwise, to put it simply, no. Not worth spending hard-earned resources on an expendable unit who dilutes what's already an underperforming Elysion pool into a more disappointing contingent. Ideally, if you do not care about Solo Raids that much, wishlist her and save.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Usage Analysis and Tier List","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-2"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Campaign (LD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Campaign (HD) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Zwei buffs piercers, which makes her a niche buffer. However, in Campaign, you only need one team. That one team usually has 2 B3 DPS slots which are used up by pierce units most of the time anyways, such as Red Hood, Alice, Maxwell, and sometimes even Snow White! Hence, we believe Zwei is an okay unit to use alongside the campaign meta units, but she is NOT better than the current existing meta units such as D: Killer Wife, Liter, Dorothy etc. This is because Zwei lacks some key things a B1 should have in Campaign, with the main abilities being ATK buffs and CDR. In High Deficit Campaign, this become extremely apparent as Zwei falls off in usability by a decent margin.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Boss (Solo) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"A","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":" | Boss (Adds) - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Against Bosses, we will be focusing on Raids. In Union Raids, Zwei does not have a spot. However, in Solo Raids, Zwei has a strong case to be used in the Snow White - Yulha team against Solo Bosses over Miranda for the average player who do not like to mald for crits. Miranda's crit buffs carry her hard as they substantially increase Snow White's damage, provided you press the reset button enough times. However, if you do not crit your shots, SW's nuke with Zwei hits harder! Another reason to use Zwei is possibly as a pair of Tia, when Naga is stolen by Crown. This gives both Tia's Attack Damage buffs and Zwei's Pierce Damage Buff to the team, allowing for hard hitting nukes by SnowWhite. One final use-case for Zwei over Miranda is when Maxwell is used over Yulha as a pair of SW, which was seen in the StormBringer Solo Raid. All of this can add towards pulling one copy of Zwei for competitive players who want to try and do better in Solo Raids! Against Bosses with Adds, SW is less usable, and hence, Zwei herself is less usable in the meta.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"PVP - ","nodeType":"text"},{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"B","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-5"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Dual Wielding Shotguns!? Initially sounded juicy burst gen for PvP, right? Unfortunately that is not the case. Zwei wields Dual SG, each ejecting 5 pellets every time she shoots. The Burst Generation is 0.35% for each pellet, so she generates 3.5% energy for each shot as a whole. This places her on similar levels as Nihilister in 2RL, and at xMica level in other speeds in PvP. To compare, ordinary clip SGs generate 4.5% energy per shot.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Her normal attacks still only hit 10 pellets in total, 5 each from both guns. Hence, her Burst gen is on average below most units, and is more or less comparable to xMica. While xMica provides a decent ATK buff for the whole team, Zwei provides pierce damage buffs, which, while Alice and Red Hood appreciate them, are not much of a benefit to them since: firstly, these 2 units already do enough damage without buffs to kill opponent teams, and secondly, they have their own problems that they deal with. Hence, the decision we have come to is that Zwei is unneeded in the current meta in PvP, but is usable as a mid tier unit for when you lack good PvP units.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"}],"nodeType":"document"}

skillAnalysis.raw: {"nodeType":"document","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"heading-2","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Kit Analysis","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Zwei plays a supportive role and lacks notable offense capabilities. Her skillset revolves around Pierce Damage and just Pierce Damage, literally! In total, she can grant up to ","marks":[],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":"~45.7% Pierce Damage","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" for your team, which is substantial, but its niche usability relegates her into a secondary role. She also helps with survivability but there is some catch.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"As a reminder, Pierce Damage belongs to the same group as Attack Damage & Parts Damage, so you need to beware of potential dilutions.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 1 - Heaven of Penetration","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Zwei's S1 consists of two components.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The first component grants modest Pierce Damage boost to the next shot fired by every unit in your team. This favors SW and Maxwell as all their Burst Damage is contained within that one shot, not so much for others and can even be deemed trivial.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"The second component grants continuous Pierce Damage for 10s to everyone in the team upon entering Full Burst. This synergizes well with Red Hood, Alice, Laplace, and literally any units with Pierce capabilities.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Although Zwei pairs best with SW and Maxwell, she can still be paired with these other Piercers. You are only missing ~20% Pierce Damage, and her ~25% is still greater than D:Wife's ~18.61%. But, please do note that she does not offer CDR nor ATK buff, which we believe is a tangible downgrade from D: Wife's complete arsenal. Her usage may also lead to \"slot pressure\".","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"### What is Slot Pressure?","marks":[{"type":"bold"},{"type":"underline"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Using Zwei almost always necessitates the inclusion of B2 CDRs, creating what pros call \"slot pressure\", where a slot is occupied by a less impactful unit and thus wasted. This is because B2s generally have weaker kits compared to B1s (like Dolla having borderline zero impact and SHelm being effective against Electric bosses only).","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 2 - Gacha Inside Gacha!","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Zwei also provides Cover HP Recovery, which is useful when Cover HP is more effective than regular healing (such as against Nihilister & Ultra). However, in other situations, it functions similarly to regular healing that does not interfere with HP mechanics (like Guillotine) with reduced reliability due to potential breaches and mandatory \"take covers\" that can lead to DPS loss. They are inefficient against bosses that pierce covers or deal repetitive attacks in a short window (your units in cover for too long = DPS loss). Besides that, destroyed covers cannot be healed, so if they were breached, Zwei would lose her regenerative powers.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"In general, cover healing is worse for everything but bossing. This is due to the fact that, at High Deficit, wall stages contain farters or raptures that would shatter your cover instantly. Moreover, bosses with Burst Damage like Modernia would render cover healing useless.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Since Zwei's basic attack is classified as only one instance of attack (despite her being Dual SG), her Cover HP Recovery should theoretically trigger every ~4.08s on average without any buff/debuff, but Cube, Max Ammo, Reload Speed, and Attack Speed will all shorten the interval. Note that this number has already incorporated her base reload time.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Since it is also a basic Cover HP Recovery effect, it can also prompt Tia's CDR passive ability, so theoretically they can be used with together, but whether splitting Tia & Naga is optimal for Raids is yet to be researched. The idea is that you pair Crown + Naga and Tia + Zwei for better DPS funneling.","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"All of these help Ein Zwei also increases the team's Critical Rate, but it is negligible except on units that already have lots of Critical Damage; wield weapons that have poor accuracy (SGs, SMGs); or have Skill Damage a major portion of their DPS (Summer Sakura). Why so? It is because the formula dictates that CRIT is more valuable against bosses without core or outside optimal range as these dilute multipliers.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"But, Zwei's CRIT Rate only lasts 5 seconds! It barely matters for anything but intermittent attacks with concentrated firepower. Take Snow White's Burst Skill, for example. When playing her, you can technically fish for CRIT, making CRIT Rate more of an RNG attenuation tool than a DPS boosting tool. In other words, you still need to \"gacha\" for critical hits. Furthermore, you still have to land SW's Burst Skill within 5s of activating Zwei's Burst Skill (note that the cycle from B1 ➔ B3 takes time!).","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"blockquote","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"For tryhards who spend hours restarting Raid runs for maximum damage, this extra Critical Rate is more of a QoL improvement more than anything, with the only problem being the buff lasts for 5 seconds only. Compared that to Miranda, who technically gives more Critical Damage (thus higher damage ceiling) but without Critical Rate (harder RNG). Do you think the improved RNG a fair tradeoff for lower damage ceiling?","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Burst -  First Summer Nostalgia","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Our initial impression is simply \"what\". Her special charged weapon lowers her DPS. Sure, it helps reload her magazine, but why? Is that one piercing SR ammo with barely any damage going to do anything? It is like having a flashback to Nikke's first summer when a particular Water-element DPS unit was released. She was supposed to melt Fire bosses but, even after buffs, she was no better than eye candy.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Well, at least Zwei's Burst Skill still provides a meaty Pierce Damage boost, which actually rocks depending on whom you match her with. It lasts 10 seconds too, which is plenty for the duration of common Burst Skills.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-2","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Gear Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"There is no need to OL Zwei's gear.","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Essential:","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" None","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Ideal:","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" None","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Passable:","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" None","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]},{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Priority:","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}},{"nodeType":"text","value":" None","marks":[],"data":{}}]}]}]},{"nodeType":"heading-5","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill Investments","marks":[],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Skill 1: 4/7/10","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"data":{}}]},{"nodeType":"unordered-list","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"list-item","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"paragraph","data":{},"content":[{"nodeType":"text","value":"Half of her buffs lie in this skill. Let’s dive right into a quick summary, shall we?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"value":"Can you give a brief summary about this unit?","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"heading-6"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"Be it consistent pierce DPS (e.g. Red Hood or Milk: Blooming Bunny), or be it nuke-type pierce DPS (e.g. Snow White or Maxwell), Zwei now comes to the battlefield with her bag packed with up to ~85% more Pierce Damage▲. ZweiTr is here to make a statement!","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"As a cherry on top, she now also provides up to an immense 63.63% Crit Rate buff! This is especially synergistic with, you guessed it, Snow White, who has an internal crit rate buff that can allow for a confirmed crit-hit. This is also notably impressive for a unit like Bunny Milk, who has so many other high-value internal buffs, that Crit buffs are one of the better options to provide to her.","nodeType":"text"}],"nodeType":"paragraph"},{"data":{},"content":[{"data":{},"marks":[],"value":"However, Zwei’s weakness is clear. Her professional ability is but a niche. Without pierce being relevant, she is likely to not see any use at all, which is often the case in all elements but Iron-Weak. Furthermore, she lacks a Burst 2 with whom she can effectively synergise with. While Grave might be a good unit to pair her with, both of them provide the same type of buff with high values, which dilutes the effectiveness of their buffs.
